     4	/-!
     5	# The EPR projection in Pauli extraction
     6	
     7	The product of the averaged, paired X and Z observables is the rank-one
     8	projection onto the EPR vector. This is an algebraic prerequisite for constructing
     9	the auxiliary state in `exists_extractionWitness_ofGlobalPairWitness`.
    10	
    11	## References
    12	
    13	Blueprint `lem:qld-unitary`; paper
    14	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1725-1742`.
    15	-/
    16	
    17	open scoped BigOperators Matrix
    18	
    19	namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT.Extraction
    20	
    21	open MIPStarRE.Quantum MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries
    22	
    23	noncomputable section
    24	
    25	variable {K ι : Type*} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
    26	  [Algebra (ZMod 2) K] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    27	
    28	/-- The operator `H_W` of the EPR projection argument, averaged over all
    29	generalized Pauli labels. Paper lines 1725-1733 define this average after
    30	reindexing by a nonzero element of the binary basis. -/
    31	def pauliCorrelation (W : PauliKind) : Op ((ι → K) × (ι → K)) :=
    32	  (Fintype.card (ι → K) : ℂ)⁻¹ •
    33	    ∑ u : ι → K, heteroKron (tauObservable W u) (tauObservable W u)
    34	
    35	private theorem avg_phaseSign_dotProduct (v : ι → K) :
    36	    (Fintype.card (ι → K) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
    37	        ∑ u : ι → K, phaseSign (binTrace K (dotProduct u v)) =
    38	      if v = 0 then 1 else 0 := by
    39	  have h := congrArg (fun A : Op (ι → K) => A v v)
    40	    (pauliProj_eq_avg_tauObservable .Z (0 : ι → K))
    41	  have hv : pauliProj .Z (0 : ι → K) v v = if v = 0 then 1 else 0 := by
    42	    change (∏ i, if v i = 0 then (1 : ℂ) else 0) *
    43	      star (∏ i, if v i = 0 then (1 : ℂ) else 0) = _
    44	    simp only [Fintype.prod_boole, ← funext_iff]
    45	    change (if v = 0 then (1 : ℂ) else 0) * star (if v = 0 then 1 else 0) = _
    46	    split <;> simp
    47	  simp only [dotProduct_zero, map_zero, phaseSign, ite_true, one_smul] at h
    48	  rw [hv] at h
    49	  simpa only [Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.sum_apply, smul_eq_mul,
    50	    tauObservable_Z_apply, ite_true, one_mul] using h.symm
    51	
    52	/-- The Z correlation projects onto equal computational-basis labels.
    53	This is the Fourier cancellation in paper lines 1736-1740. -/
    54	theorem pauliCorrelation_Z_apply (x y : (ι → K) × (ι → K)) :
    55	    pauliCorrelation .Z x y = if x = y ∧ y.1 = y.2 then 1 else 0 := by
    56	  simp only [pauliCorrelation, Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.sum_apply, smul_eq_mul,
    57	    heteroKron, Matrix.kronecker, Matrix.kroneckerMap_apply]
    58	  simp_rw [tauObservable_Z_apply]
    59	  by_cases hxy : x = y
    60	  · subst x
    61	    simp only [ite_true, true_and]
    62	    have hphase (u : ι → K) :
    63	        phaseSign (binTrace K (dotProduct u y.1)) *
    64	            phaseSign (binTrace K (dotProduct u y.2)) =
    65	          phaseSign (binTrace K (dotProduct u (y.1 + y.2))) := by
    66	      rw [← phaseSign_add, dotProduct_add, map_add]
    67	    simp_rw [hphase]
    68	    rw [avg_phaseSign_dotProduct]
    69	    letI : CharP K 2 := (Algebra.charP_iff (ZMod 2) K 2).mp (ZMod.charP 2)
    70	    simp only [funext_iff, Pi.add_apply, Pi.zero_apply, CharTwo.add_eq_zero]
    71	  · have h : x.1 ≠ y.1 ∨ x.2 ≠ y.2 := by
    72	      by_contra h
    73	      push Not at h
    74	      exact hxy (Prod.ext h.1 h.2)
    75	    rcases h with h | h <;> simp [h, hxy]
    76	
    77	/-- On a diagonal input, the X correlation is uniform over diagonal outputs.
    78	This is the shift average in paper lines 1739-1742. -/
    79	theorem pauliCorrelation_X_apply_diagonal (x : (ι → K) × (ι → K)) (a : ι → K) :
    80	    pauliCorrelation .X x (a, a) =
    81	      if x.1 = x.2 then (Fintype.card (ι → K) : ℂ)⁻¹ else 0 := by
    82	  simp only [pauliCorrelation, Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.sum_apply, smul_eq_mul,
    83	    heteroKron, Matrix.kronecker, Matrix.kroneckerMap_apply]
    84	  simp_rw [tauObservable_X_apply]
    85	  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (x.1 - a)]
    86	  · simp [add_sub_cancel, eq_comm]
    87	  · intro u _ hu
    88	    have h : x.1 ≠ a + u := by
    89	      intro h
    90	      apply hu
    91	      rw [h, add_sub_cancel_left]
    92	    simp [h]
    93	  · simp
    94	
    95	/-- The product `H_X H_Z` is the ordinary rank-one EPR projection, with no
    96	normalized-trace factor. This is the identity at paper lines 1735-1742 used
    97	to construct the auxiliary state in blueprint `lem:qld-unitary`. -/
    98	theorem pauliCorrelation_mul_eq_epr :
    99	    pauliCorrelation (K := K) (ι := ι) .X * pauliCorrelation .Z =
   100	      Matrix.vecMulVec (fun x => eprState (ι → K) x)
   101	        (fun y => star (eprState (ι → K) y)) := by
   102	  ext x y
   103	  rw [Matrix.mul_apply]
   104	  simp_rw [pauliCorrelation_Z_apply]
   105	  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single y]
   106	  · by_cases hy : y.1 = y.2
   107	    · rcases y with ⟨a, b⟩
   108	      dsimp only at hy
   109	      subst b
   110	      rw [if_pos ⟨rfl, rfl⟩, mul_one, pauliCorrelation_X_apply_diagonal]
   111	      change (if x.1 = x.2 then (Fintype.card (ι → K) : ℂ)⁻¹ else 0) =
   112	        (if x.1 = x.2 then (Real.sqrt (Fintype.card (ι → K) : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ else 0) *
   113	          star (if a = a then (Real.sqrt (Fintype.card (ι → K) : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ else 0)
   114	      by_cases hx : x.1 = x.2
   115	      · rw [if_pos hx, if_pos hx, if_pos rfl]
   116	        exact (inv_sqrt_natCast_mul_conj (Fintype.card (ι → K))).symm
   117	      · simp [hx]
   118	    · simp [hy, Matrix.vecMulVec_apply, eprState]
   119	  · intro z _ hz
   120	    simp [hz]
   121	  · simp
   122	
   123	/-- Each Pauli correlation average, with an arbitrary auxiliary register,
   124	is a contraction. The triangle inequality
   125	and the unitarity of its summands justify the norm estimate used in paper
   126	lines 1743-1750, independently of any strategy-consistency hypothesis. -/
   127	theorem norm_heteroKron_pauliCorrelation_apply_le {R : Type*}
   128	    [Fintype R] [DecidableEq R] (W : PauliKind)
   129	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (R × ((ι → K) × (ι → K)))) :
   130	    ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron (1 : Op R) (pauliCorrelation W)) ψ‖ ≤ ‖ψ‖ := by
   131	  let U (u : ι → K) :=
   132	    heteroKron (1 : Op R) (heteroKron (tauObservable W u) (tauObservable W u))
   133	  have hnorm (u : ι → K) :
   134	      ‖applyOperatorToState (U u) ψ‖ = ‖ψ‖ := by
   135	    apply MagicSquareRigidity.norm_toEuclideanLin_of_conjTranspose_mul_eq_one
   136	    simp only [U, heteroKron, Matrix.kronecker, Matrix.conjTranspose_kronecker,
   137	      Matrix.conjTranspose_one]
   138	    change heteroKron 1 (heteroKron (tauObservable W u)ᴴ (tauObservable W u)ᴴ) *
   139	      heteroKron 1 (heteroKron (tauObservable W u) (tauObservable W u)) = 1
   140	    rw [heteroKron_mul, heteroKron_mul, tauObservable_conjTranspose_mul_self,
   141	      heteroKron_one_one, Matrix.one_mul, heteroKron_one_one]
   142	  have haction : applyOperatorToState (heteroKron (1 : Op R) (pauliCorrelation W)) ψ =
   143	      (Fintype.card (ι → K) : ℂ)⁻¹ • ∑ u : ι → K,
   144	        applyOperatorToState (U u) ψ := by
   145	    change applyOperatorToState
   146	      ((Matrix.kroneckerBilinear (R := ℂ) (α := ℂ) (1 : Op R))
   147	        ((Fintype.card (ι → K) : ℂ)⁻¹ •
   148	          ∑ u : ι → K, heteroKron (tauObservable W u) (tauObservable W u))) ψ = _
   149	    simp only [map_smul, map_sum, applyOperatorToState, LinearMap.sum_apply,
   150	      LinearMap.smul_apply]
   151	    rfl
   152	  rw [haction, norm_smul]
   153	  calc
   154	    _ ≤ ‖(Fintype.card (ι → K) : ℂ)⁻¹‖ * ∑ u : ι → K,
   155	        ‖applyOperatorToState (U u) ψ‖ :=
   156	      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (norm_sum_le _ _) (norm_nonneg _)
   157	    _ = ‖ψ‖ := by
   158	      simp only [hnorm, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul]
   159	      rw [norm_inv, Complex.norm_natCast, ← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀, one_mul]
   160	      positivity

   162	/-- Near-perfect X and Z correlations force proximity to the EPR subspace.
   163	This is the corrected projection estimate for paper lines 1743-1767, with
   164	arbitrary auxiliary registers. It uses the product identity and contraction
   165	bounds, and avoids the invalid squared-triangle estimate in the source. -/
   166	theorem norm_sub_eprProjection_le {R : Type*} [Fintype R] [DecidableEq R]
   167	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (R × ((ι → K) × (ι → K)))) (hψ : ‖ψ‖ = 1)
   168	    (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ)
   169	    (hcorr : ∀ W : PauliKind,
   170	      1 - δ / 2 ≤ (inner ℂ ψ
   171	        (applyOperatorToState (heteroKron (1 : Op R) (pauliCorrelation W)) ψ)).re) :
   172	    ‖ψ - applyOperatorToState
   173	      (heteroKron (1 : Op R) (Matrix.vecMulVec (fun x => eprState (ι → K) x)
   174	        (fun y => star (eprState (ι → K) y)))) ψ‖ ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt δ := by
   175	  let H (W : PauliKind) := heteroKron (1 : Op R) (pauliCorrelation (K := K) (ι := ι) W)
   176	  have hdist (W : PauliKind) : ‖ψ - applyOperatorToState (H W) ψ‖ ≤ Real.sqrt δ := by
   177	    have hn := norm_heteroKron_pauliCorrelation_apply_le W ψ
   178	    rw [hψ] at hn
   179	    have hs : ‖applyOperatorToState (H W) ψ‖ ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
   180	      dsimp only [H]
   181	      nlinarith [norm_nonneg (applyOperatorToState (H W) ψ)]
   182	    have he := norm_sub_sq (𝕜 := ℂ) ψ (applyOperatorToState (H W) ψ)
   183	    rw [hψ] at he
   184	    change ‖ψ - applyOperatorToState (H W) ψ‖ ^ 2 =
   185	      1 ^ 2 - 2 * (inner ℂ ψ (applyOperatorToState (H W) ψ)).re +
   186	        ‖applyOperatorToState (H W) ψ‖ ^ 2 at he
   187	    have hc := hcorr W
   188	    change 1 - δ / 2 ≤ (inner ℂ ψ (applyOperatorToState (H W) ψ)).re at hc
   189	    nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt hδ, Real.sqrt_nonneg δ,
   190	      norm_nonneg (ψ - applyOperatorToState (H W) ψ)]
   191	  have hprod : H .X * H .Z =
   192	      heteroKron (1 : Op R) (Matrix.vecMulVec (fun x => eprState (ι → K) x)
   193	        (fun y => star (eprState (ι → K) y))) := by
   194	    dsimp only [H]
   195	    rw [heteroKron_mul, Matrix.one_mul, pauliCorrelation_mul_eq_epr]
   196	  rw [← hprod, DistanceCalculus.applyOperatorToState_mul]
   197	  calc
   198	    _ ≤ ‖ψ - applyOperatorToState (H .X) ψ‖ +
   199	        ‖applyOperatorToState (H .X) ψ -
   200	          applyOperatorToState (H .X) (applyOperatorToState (H .Z) ψ)‖ :=
   201	      norm_sub_le_norm_sub_add_norm_sub _ _ _
   202	    _ ≤ Real.sqrt δ + Real.sqrt δ := add_le_add (hdist .X) (by
   203	      rw [← MagicSquareRigidity.applyOperatorToState_sub]
   204	      exact (norm_heteroKron_pauliCorrelation_apply_le .X _).trans (hdist .Z))
   205	    _ = 2 * Real.sqrt δ := by ring
   206	
   207	end

     4	/-!
     5	# The auxiliary vector from the EPR projection
     6	
     7	Taking the partial inner product with the EPR vector constructs the
     8	unnormalized auxiliary vector. Tensoring it with EPR gives exactly the
     9	orthogonal projection of the original vector onto the EPR subspace.
    10	
    11	## References
    12	
    13	Blueprint `lem:qld-unitary`; paper
    14	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1769-1783`.
    15	-/

    25	/-- Move each extracted register before its auxiliary registers. This
    26	permutation puts the ideal state in the order used by
    27	`MagicSquareRigidity.exists_unit_residual`. -/
    28	def extractionEprFirstEquiv (P : AdmissibleParams) (ιA ιB : Type*) :
    29	    SixReg P ιA ιB ≃
    30	      (PauliRegister P × (ιA × PauliRegister P)) ×
    31	        (PauliRegister P × (ιB × PauliRegister P)) :=
    32	  (sixRegExtractionEquiv P ιA ιB).trans
    33	    (Equiv.prodCongr (Equiv.prodComm _ _) (Equiv.prodComm _ _))
    34

    37	/-- Partial inner product with the EPR vector, leaving the auxiliary index.
    38	This is the coordinate form of the vector defined at paper line 1769. -/
    39	def eprPartialInner {R V : Type*} [Fintype R] [DecidableEq R]
    40	    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [Nonempty V]
    41	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (R × (V × V))) : EuclideanSpace ℂ R :=
    42	  (EuclideanSpace.equiv R ℂ).symm
    43	    (fun r => ∑ p : V × V, star (eprState V p) * ψ (r, p))
    44	
    45	/-- Tensoring the EPR partial inner product with EPR gives the rank-one
    46	projection on the second tensor factor. This is the projection equality in
    47	paper lines 1776-1779; no normalization of the auxiliary vector is assumed. -/
    48	theorem vecTensor_eprPartialInner {R V : Type*} [Fintype R] [DecidableEq R]
    49	    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [Nonempty V]
    50	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (R × (V × V))) :
    51	    vecTensor (eprPartialInner ψ) (eprState V) =
    52	      applyOperatorToState
    53	        (heteroKron (1 : Op R) (Matrix.vecMulVec (fun x => eprState V x)
    54	          (fun y => star (eprState V y)))) ψ := by
    55	  ext x
    56	  change (∑ p : V × V, star (eprState V p) * ψ (x.1, p)) * eprState V x.2 =
    57	    ∑ j : R × (V × V),
    58	      ((1 : Op R) x.1 j.1 * (eprState V x.2 * star (eprState V j.2))) * ψ j
    59	  conv_rhs => rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    60	  simp only [Matrix.one_apply, ite_mul, one_mul, zero_mul]
    61	  conv_rhs => rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    62	  simp only [Finset.sum_ite_eq, Finset.mem_univ, ite_true]
    63	  rw [Finset.sum_mul]
    64	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    65	  intro p _
    66	  ring
    67	
    68	end Extraction

    76	/-- In EPR-first local coordinates, the ideal extraction state is the target
    77	of the existing auxiliary-state normalization theorem. -/
    78	theorem reindexState_idealExpState
    79	    (aux : EuclideanSpace ℂ
    80	      (ExtractionAuxRegisters P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)) :
    81	    reindexState (extractionEprFirstEquiv P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)
    82	        (S.idealExpState aux) =
    83	      reindexState prodShuffle (vecTensor (eprState (PauliRegister P)) aux) := by
    84	  ext index
    85	  change aux ((index.1.2.1, index.1.2.2), (index.2.2.1, index.2.2.2)) *
    86	      eprState (PauliRegister P) (index.1.1, index.2.1) =
    87	    eprState (PauliRegister P) (index.1.1, index.2.1) * aux (index.1.2, index.2.2)
    88	  exact mul_comm _ _
    89	
    90	/-- Tensoring an auxiliary vector with EPR preserves its norm. -/
    91	theorem idealExpState_norm
    92	    (aux : EuclideanSpace ℂ
    93	      (ExtractionAuxRegisters P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)) :
    94	    ‖S.idealExpState aux‖ = ‖aux‖ := by
    95	  rw [idealExpState, reindexState_norm_eq, vecTensor_norm_eq, eprState_norm, mul_one]
    96	
    97	/-- A normalized reference vector on `AA'BB'`, formed from the original state
    98	and one EPR pair. It is used when the EPR projection of the given state vanishes. -/
    99	def extractionAuxReference : EuclideanSpace ℂ
   100	    (ExtractionAuxRegisters P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB) :=
   101	  reindexState prodShuffle (vecTensor S.toStrategy.ψ (eprState (PauliRegister P)))
   102	
   103	/-- The reference auxiliary vector has norm one. -/
   104	theorem extractionAuxReference_norm : ‖S.extractionAuxReference‖ = 1 := by
   105	  rw [extractionAuxReference, reindexState_norm_eq, vecTensor_norm_eq, eprState_norm,
   106	    S.toStrategy.ψ_norm, one_mul]
   107	
   108	/-- The EPR projection on registers `A''B''`, with identity on `AA'BB'`.
   109	Paper lines 1766-1769 use this projection to select the auxiliary vector. -/
   110	def extractionEprProjection : Op (SixReg P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB) :=
   111	  reindexOp (extractionIdealShuffle P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB).symm
   112	    (heteroKron (1 : Op (ExtractionAuxRegisters P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB))
   113	      (Matrix.vecMulVec (fun x => eprState (PauliRegister P) x)
   114	        (fun y => star (eprState (PauliRegister P) y))))
   115	
   116	/-- The auxiliary vector before normalization, obtained by contracting the
   117	extracted registers against EPR. This is `aux_0` at paper line 1769. -/
   118	def extractionAux0
   119	    (θ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (SixReg P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)) :
   120	    EuclideanSpace ℂ (ExtractionAuxRegisters P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB) :=
   121	  Extraction.eprPartialInner
   122	    (reindexState (extractionIdealShuffle P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB).symm θ)
   123	
   124	/-- The unnormalized ideal extraction state is the EPR projection of the
   125	given six-register state. This identifies the actual auxiliary construction
   126	with the projection in paper lines 1776-1779, retaining the heterogeneous
   127	player spaces of blueprint `lem:qld-unitary`. -/
   128	theorem idealExpState_extractionAux0
   129	    (θ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (SixReg P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)) :
   130	    S.idealExpState (S.extractionAux0 θ) =
   131	      applyOperatorToState S.extractionEprProjection θ := by
   132	  unfold idealExpState extractionAux0
   133	  rw [Extraction.vecTensor_eprPartialInner]
   134	  ext x
   135	  let e := (extractionIdealShuffle P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB).symm
   136	  let T := heteroKron
   137	    (1 : Op (ExtractionAuxRegisters P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB))
   138	    (Matrix.vecMulVec (fun x => eprState (PauliRegister P) x)
   139	      (fun y => star (eprState (PauliRegister P) y)))
   140	  change (T *ᵥ (fun j => θ (e.symm j))) (e x) =
   141	    ((T.submatrix e e) *ᵥ (fun j => θ j)) x
   142	  exact (congrFun (Matrix.submatrix_mulVec_equiv T (fun j => θ j) e e) x).symm
   143	
   144	/-- Normalize the projected auxiliary vector, at twice the projection error.
   145	This is the normalization step at paper lines 1773-1783. The existing
   146	normalization theorem also covers a zero projection, using the reference
   147	vector above; no nonvanishing assumption is added. -/
   148	theorem exists_unit_aux_near_eprProjection
   149	    (θ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (SixReg P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)) (hθ : ‖θ‖ = 1) :
   150	    ∃ aux : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ExtractionAuxRegisters P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB),
   151	      ‖aux‖ = 1 ∧ ‖θ - S.idealExpState aux‖ ≤
   152	        2 * ‖θ - applyOperatorToState S.extractionEprProjection θ‖ := by
   153	  let e := extractionEprFirstEquiv P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB
   154	  have hdist (aux : EuclideanSpace ℂ
   155	      (ExtractionAuxRegisters P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)) :
   156	      ‖reindexState e θ -
   157	        reindexState prodShuffle (vecTensor (eprState (PauliRegister P)) aux)‖ =
   158	          ‖θ - S.idealExpState aux‖ := by
   159	    rw [← S.reindexState_idealExpState]
   160	    exact (LinearIsometryEquiv.piLpCongrLeft 2 ℂ ℂ e).norm_map (θ - S.idealExpState aux)
   161	  obtain ⟨aux, haux, hclose⟩ := MagicSquareRigidity.exists_unit_residual
   162	    (reindexState e θ) (by rwa [reindexState_norm_eq])
   163	    S.extractionAuxReference S.extractionAuxReference_norm
   164	    ‖θ - applyOperatorToState S.extractionEprProjection θ‖ (S.extractionAux0 θ)
   165	    (((hdist (S.extractionAux0 θ)).trans
   166	      (congrArg (fun v => ‖θ - v‖) (S.idealExpState_extractionAux0 θ))).le)
   167	  exact ⟨aux, haux, (hdist aux).symm.trans_le hclose⟩
   168

   112	theorem sum_conj_pauli_sq (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG)
   113	    (side : PlayerSide) (W : PauliKind) :
   114	    ∑ h : PauliRegister P,
   115	      (conjBy (S.placeSide side (swapUnitary w side))
   116	        (S.placePlayer side ((S.pauliMeas side W).effect h)))ᴴ *
   117	      conjBy (S.placeSide side (swapUnitary w side))
   118	        (S.placePlayer side ((S.pauliMeas side W).effect h)) = 1 := by

   129	  change (∑ h, (conjBy U _)ᴴ * conjBy U _) = 1
   130	  simp_rw [hterm]
   131	  rw [← Finset.sum_mul, ← Matrix.mul_sum, S.sum_placePlayer_pauli_sq,

   135	most four, uniformly in the local dimensions and number of answers. -/
   136	theorem extraction_pauli_dist_le_four (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG)

   428	      pauliProj W (h + decodeFq (W.selectPoly pair)) := by
   429	  classical
   430	  rw [pauliProj_eq_avg_tauObservable, conjBy, Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.smul_mul,
   431	    Matrix.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul, pauliProj_eq_avg_tauObservable]
   432	  congr 1
   433	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   434	  intro u _
   435	  rw [Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.smul_mul]
   436	  change _ • conjBy _ _ = _
   437	  rw [swapPauli_conj_tauObservable, smul_smul]
   438	  congr 1
   439	  rw [fixedBinTrace, ← phaseSign_add, ← map_add,
   440	    dotProduct_comm (decodeFq (W.selectPoly pair)) u, dotProduct_add]
   441	
   442	/-- Translation of the Pauli label translates its dot-product outcome. This
   443	is the finite reindexing in paper
   444	`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1805-1822`; it does not require a
   445	polynomial to be in the image of the low-degree encoding. -/
   446	private theorem swapPauli_conj_tauDotProj {P : AdmissibleParams}
   447	    (pair : PolyPair P) (W : PauliKind) (u : PauliRegister P) (a : PauliScalar P) :
   448	    conjBy (tauObservable .X (decodeFq pair.2) * tauObservable .Z (decodeFq pair.1))
   449	        (tauDotProj W u a) =
   450	      tauDotProj W u (a + dotProduct (decodeFq (W.selectPoly pair)) u) := by
   451	  classical
   452	  simp only [tauDotProj, bracketOp, conjBy, Matrix.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
   453	  change (∑ h ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun h => dotProduct h u = a),
   454	    conjBy (tauObservable .X (decodeFq pair.2) * tauObservable .Z (decodeFq pair.1))
   455	      (pauliProj W h)) = _
   456	  simp_rw [swapPauli_conj_pauliProj]
   457	  apply Finset.sum_equiv (Equiv.addRight (decodeFq (W.selectPoly pair)))
   458	  · intro h
   459	    simp [add_dotProduct]
   460	  · intro h _
   461	    rfl
   462	
   463	/-- The swap map built from the global polynomial-pair measurement, with the
   464	crossed decoded arguments required by `def:v-swap-unitary`. Blueprint
   465	`def:v-swap-unitary`; paper
   466	`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1687-1700`. -/
   467	noncomputable def swapUnitary {P : AdmissibleParams} {epsilon delta : ℝ}
   468	    {S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon} (w : GlobalPairWitness S delta)
   469	    (side : PlayerSide) : Op (ExtractionBlock P (S.LocalSpace side)) :=
   470	  ∑ pair : PolyPair P,
   471	    heteroKron ((w.Smeas side).effect pair)
   472	      (tauObservable .X (decodeFq pair.2) *
   473	        tauObservable .Z (decodeFq pair.1))
   474	
   475	/-- The swap map is a right unitary. This is the first exact unitarity
   476	calculation of blueprint
   477	`lem:v-swap-conjugation`, paper
   478	`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1687-1699`.
   479	
   480	Projectivity and completeness of `w.Smeas side` reduce the product to its
   481	diagonal outcomes. The two Pauli involutions then cancel in reverse order. -/
   482	theorem swapUnitary_mul_conjTranspose {P : AdmissibleParams}
   483	    {epsilon delta : ℝ} {S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon}
   484	    (w : GlobalPairWitness S delta) (side : PlayerSide) :
   485	    swapUnitary w side * (swapUnitary w side)ᴴ = 1 := by
   486	  classical
   487	  apply sum_heteroKron_mul_conjTranspose (w.Smeas side) (w.projective side)
   488	  exact swapPauli_mul_conjTranspose
   489	
   490	/-- The swap map is a left unitary. This is the reverse exact unitarity
   491	calculation implicit in blueprint
   492	`lem:v-swap-conjugation`, paper
   493	`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1687-1699`.
   494	
   495	For finite square matrices, the right inverse identity also gives the left
   496	inverse identity. -/
   497	theorem conjTranspose_mul_swapUnitary {P : AdmissibleParams}
   498	    {epsilon delta : ℝ} {S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon}
   499	    (w : GlobalPairWitness S delta) (side : PlayerSide) :
   500	    (swapUnitary w side)ᴴ * swapUnitary w side = 1 := by
   501	  exact mul_eq_one_comm.mp (swapUnitary_mul_conjTranspose w side)
   502	
   503	/-- Conjugation by the swap map acts separately on each joint outcome. This
   504	is the diagonal-projector reduction at paper
   505	`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1701-1713,1805-1822`. -/
   506	private theorem swapUnitary_conj_controlled {P : AdmissibleParams}
   507	    {epsilon delta : ℝ} {S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon}
   508	    (w : GlobalPairWitness S delta) (side : PlayerSide)
   509	    (R : PolyPair P → Op (PauliRegister P)) :
   510	    conjBy (swapUnitary w side)
   511	        (∑ pair, heteroKron ((w.Smeas side).effect pair) (R pair)) =
   512	      ∑ pair, heteroKron ((w.Smeas side).effect pair)
   513	        (conjBy (tauObservable .X (decodeFq pair.2) *
   514	          tauObservable .Z (decodeFq pair.1)) (R pair)) := by
   515	  have hself (pair : PolyPair P) :
   516	      ((w.Smeas side).effect pair)ᴴ = (w.Smeas side).effect pair :=
   517	    (w.projective side pair).isSelfAdjoint
   518	  simp only [conjBy, swapUnitary, Matrix.conjTranspose_sum,
   519	    MagicSquareRigidity.heteroKron_conjTranspose, hself]
   520	  rw [sum_heteroKron_mul_sum_heteroKron (w.Smeas side) (w.projective side),
   521	    sum_heteroKron_mul_sum_heteroKron (w.Smeas side) (w.projective side)]
   522	
   523	/-- Exact conjugation of a pulled-apart observable by the swap map. This is
   524	Equation `eq:v-swap-obs-conjugation` in `lem:v-swap-conjugation`, blueprint
   525	`eq:v-swap-obs-conjugation`, paper
   526	`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1701-1713`.
   527	
   528	The product form and diagonal projector reduction leave two copies of the
   529	same binary phase, whose product is one. -/
   530	theorem swapUnitary_conj_tildeObs {P : AdmissibleParams}
   531	    {epsilon delta : ℝ} {S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon}
   532	    (w : GlobalPairWitness S delta) (side : PlayerSide) (W : PauliKind)
   533	    (u : PauliRegister P) (j : Fin P.model.basisDim) :
   534	    conjBy (swapUnitary w side) (tildeObs w side W u j) =
   535	      heteroKron (1 : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace side))
   536	        (tauObservable W (P.model.basis j • u)) := by
   537	  classical
   538	  rw [tildeObs_eq_heteroKron, DistanceCalculus.heteroKron_finset_sum_left]
   539	  simp_rw [MagicSquareRigidity.heteroKron_smul_left,
   540	    ← MagicSquareRigidity.heteroKron_smul_right]
   541	  rw [swapUnitary_conj_controlled]
   542	  have hcancel (pair : PolyPair P) :
   543	      conjBy (tauObservable .X (decodeFq pair.2) * tauObservable .Z (decodeFq pair.1))
   544	        (phaseSign (fixedBinTrace P.model
   545	          (P.model.basis j * dotProduct (decodeFq (W.selectPoly pair)) u)) •
   546	            tauObservable W (P.model.basis j • u)) =
   547	        tauObservable W (P.model.basis j • u) := by
   548	    rw [conjBy, Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.smul_mul]
   549	    change _ • conjBy _ _ = _
   550	    rw [swapPauli_conj_tauObservable, smul_smul]
   551	    have hdot : dotProduct (decodeFq (W.selectPoly pair)) (P.model.basis j • u) =
   552	        P.model.basis j * dotProduct (decodeFq (W.selectPoly pair)) u := by
   553	      rw [dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul]
   554	    rw [hdot, phaseSign_mul_self, one_smul]
   555	  simp_rw [hcancel]
   556	  rw [← DistanceCalculus.heteroKron_finset_sum_left, (w.Smeas side).sum_eq_one]
   557	
   558	/-- Exact conjugation of a pulled-apart point effect by the swap map. This is
   559	Equation `eq:qld-unitary-6` in `lem:v-swap-conjugation`, blueprint
   560	`eq:qld-unitary-6`; its calculation occurs at paper
   561	`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1805-1822`.
   562	
   563	Conjugation translates each Pauli projector and its dot-product constraint.
   564	The two copies of the decoded label cancel in characteristic two. The final
   565	identification uses `lowDegreeEnc_eq_dotProduct`, not an unrestricted decoder
   566	interpolation identity. -/
   567	theorem swapUnitary_conj_tildeM {P : AdmissibleParams}
   568	    {epsilon delta : ℝ} {S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon}
   569	    (w : GlobalPairWitness S delta) (side : PlayerSide) (W : PauliKind)
   570	    (u : Fin P.m -> PauliScalar P) (a : PauliScalar P) :
   571	    conjBy (swapUnitary w side) (tildeM w side W (indicatorVec u) a) =
   572	      heteroKron (1 : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace side))
   573	        (bracketOp (pauliProj W) (fun h => lowDegreeEnc h u) a) := by
   574	  classical
   575	  have hM : tildeM w side W (indicatorVec u) a =
   576	      ∑ pair : PolyPair P, heteroKron ((w.Smeas side).effect pair)
   577	        (tauDotProj W (indicatorVec u)
   578	          (dotProduct (decodeFq (W.selectPoly pair)) (indicatorVec u) - a)) := by
   579	    simp only [tildeM, GlobalPairWitness.marginalPoly, Measurement.postprocess_effect]
   580	    simp_rw [DistanceCalculus.heteroKron_finset_sum_left]
   581	    rw [← Finset.sum_fiberwise Finset.univ W.selectPoly
   582	      (fun pair => heteroKron ((w.Smeas side).effect pair)
   583	        (tauDotProj W (indicatorVec u)
   584	          (dotProduct (decodeFq (W.selectPoly pair)) (indicatorVec u) - a)))]
   585	    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   586	    intro g _
   587	    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   588	    intro pair hpair
   589	    rw [(Finset.mem_filter.mp hpair).2]
   590	  rw [hM, swapUnitary_conj_controlled]
   591	  simp_rw [swapPauli_conj_tauDotProj]
   592	  have hcancel (b : PauliScalar P) : b - a + b = a := by
   593	    letI : CharP (PauliScalar P) 2 :=
   594	      (Algebra.charP_iff (ZMod 2) (PauliScalar P) 2).mp (ZMod.charP 2)
   595	    rw [sub_eq_add_neg, CharTwo.neg_eq, add_right_comm, CharTwo.add_self_eq_zero, zero_add]
   596	  simp_rw [hcancel]
   597	  rw [← DistanceCalculus.heteroKron_finset_sum_left, (w.Smeas side).sum_eq_one]
   598	  congr 1
   599	  simp only [tauDotProj, bracketOp, lowDegreeEnc_eq_dotProduct]
   600	
   601	end

    28	/-- Simultaneous unitary conjugation preserves the quadratic form of a product. -/
    29	theorem stateQForm_conjBy_mul_apply {I : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    30	    (U A B : Op I) (hU : Uᴴ * U = 1) (psi : EuclideanSpace ℂ I) :
    31	    stateQForm (applyOperatorToState U psi) (conjBy U A * conjBy U B) =
    32	      stateQForm psi (A * B) := by
    33	  rw [← stateQForm_conjTranspose_mul_mul]
    34	  congr 1
    35	  simp only [conjBy]
    36	  calc
    37	    _ = (Uᴴ * U) * A * (Uᴴ * U) * B * (Uᴴ * U) := by noncomm_ring
    38	    _ = A * B := by rw [hU]; simp

    45	/-- The total Pauli POVM extended to the full local extraction block and
    46	conjugated by the concrete swap. This is the measurement in `eq:qld-unitary-7`. -/
    47	def swappedPauliMeas (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG) (side : PlayerSide)
    48	    (W : PauliKind) : Measurement (PauliRegister P) (ExtractionBlock P (S.LocalSpace side)) :=
    49	  Measurement.ofSumEqOne
    50	    (fun h => conjBy (swapUnitary w side) (S.onPlayer side ((S.pauliMeas side W).effect h)))
    51	    (fun h => by
    52	      apply star_right_conjugate_nonneg
    53	      exact kronecker_nonneg
    54	        (kronecker_nonneg ((S.pauliMeas side W).pos h) Matrix.PosSemidef.one.nonneg)
    55	        Matrix.PosSemidef.one.nonneg)
    56	    (by
    57	      simp only [conjBy, onPlayer, ← Finset.sum_mul, ← Matrix.mul_sum,
    58	        ← heteroKron_finset_sum_left, (S.pauliMeas side W).sum_eq_one,
    59	        heteroKron_one_one, Matrix.mul_one, swapUnitary_mul_conjTranspose])

    81	theorem placeSide_extracted (side : PlayerSide) (T : Op (PauliRegister P)) :
    82	    S.placeSide side (heteroKron (1 : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace side)) T) =
    83	      S.placeExtractedRegister side T := by

    88	        T row.1.2.2 col.1.2.2) *
    89	        (if ((row.2.1, row.2.2.1), row.2.2.2) =
    90	          ((col.2.1, col.2.2.1), col.2.2.2) then 1 else 0) =
    91	      (if row.1.1 = col.1.1 then 1 else 0) *
    92	        (if row.1.2.1 = col.1.2.1 then 1 else 0) *

   156	/-- On the jointly swapped state, the overlap of conjugated block measurements
   157	is one minus their original consistency defect. This is simultaneous unitary
   158	invariance with the exact six-register reassociation. -/
   159	theorem swapped_block_overlap_eq (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG)
   160	    {X α : Type*} [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
   161	    (mu : Distribution X) (hmu : mu.IsProbability)
   162	    (A : X → Measurement α (ExtractionBlock P S.toStrategy.ιA))
   163	    (B : X → Measurement α (ExtractionBlock P S.toStrategy.ιB)) :
   164	    avgOver mu (fun x => ∑ a, stateQForm
   165	      (reindexState (sixRegExtractionEquiv P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)
   166	        (S.applyBoth (swapUnitary w .alice) (swapUnitary w .bob) S.psiHat))
   167	      (heteroKron (conjBy (swapUnitary w .alice) ((A x).effect a))
   168	        (conjBy (swapUnitary w .bob) ((B x).effect a)))) =
   169	      1 - consistencyDefect mu
   170	        (fun x a => S.placeSide .alice ((A x).effect a))
   171	        (fun x a => S.placeSide .bob ((B x).effect a)) S.psiHat := by
   172	  have h := consistencyDefect_eq_one_sub_overlap mu
   173	    (fun x => S.blockMeasurement .alice (A x))
   174	    (fun x => S.blockMeasurement .bob (B x)) S.psiHat hmu S.psiHat_norm
   175	  simp only [blockMeasurement_effect] at h
   176	  rw [h, sub_sub_cancel]
   177	  apply avgOver_congr
   178	  intro x
   179	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   180	  intro a _
   181	  rw [WinImplications.stateQForm_reindexState, S.reindexOp_heteroKron_eq_placeSides]

   183	    ← S.conjBy_placeBoth_swap_placeSide w .bob]
   184	  exact stateQForm_conjBy_mul_apply _ _ _ (S.placeBoth_swap_left_unitary w) S.psiHat

   187	/-- Alice's evaluated swapped total-Pauli overlap with Bob's canonical

   189	theorem swapped_pauli_overlap_alice (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG) (W : PauliKind) :
   190	    avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)) (fun u =>
   191	      ∑ a : PauliScalar P, stateQForm
   192	        (reindexState (sixRegExtractionEquiv P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)
   193	          (S.applyBoth (swapUnitary w .alice) (swapUnitary w .bob) S.psiHat))
   194	        (heteroKron (((S.swappedPauliMeas w .alice W).postprocess
   195	          (fun h => evalPoly (encodingPoly h) u)).effect a)
   196	          (((rightPlacedMeasurement (ιA := S.ExpandedLocalSpace .bob)
   197	            (pauliRegisterMeas (params := P) W)).postprocess
   198	            (fun h => evalPoly (encodingPoly h) u)).effect a))) =
   199	      1 - consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P))

     3	/-!
     4	# Finite controlled unitaries
     5	
     6	A complete projective measurement controls a family of operators on a second
     7	finite-dimensional space. Orthogonality of the measurement effects makes
     8	multiplication of the resulting operator sums componentwise. In particular,
     9	unitary components give a unitary controlled operator.
    10	
    11	These are formalization-only algebraic lemmas, not the extraction theorem:
    12	they do not construct the global measurement or establish the Pauli relations.
    13	
    14	## References
    15	
    16	- `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1687-1700`,
    17	  the unitarity calculation in the proof of `lem:qld-unitary`.
    18	- Blueprint `def:v-swap-unitary` and `lem:v-swap-conjugation`.
    19	-/
    20	
    21	open scoped BigOperators Matrix
    22	
    23	namespace MIPStarRE.Quantum
    24	
    25	open MIPStarRE.QPBT
    26	
    27	variable {Outcome Control Target : Type*}
    28	variable [Fintype Outcome] [Fintype Control] [DecidableEq Control]
    29	variable [Fintype Target]
    30	
    31	/-- Multiplication of operator sums controlled by the same projective measurement
    32	is componentwise. This isolates the orthogonality calculation in the proof of
    33	`lem:qld-unitary`, before any unitarity of the controlled components is used. -/
    34	theorem sum_heteroKron_mul_sum_heteroKron
    35	    (measurement : Measurement Outcome Control)
    36	    (hprojective : MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective measurement)
    37	    (leftOperators rightOperators : Outcome → Op Target) :
    38	    (∑ outcome, heteroKron (measurement.effect outcome) (leftOperators outcome)) *
    39	        (∑ outcome, heteroKron (measurement.effect outcome) (rightOperators outcome)) =
    40	      ∑ outcome, heteroKron (measurement.effect outcome)
    41	        (leftOperators outcome * rightOperators outcome) := by
    42	  classical
    43	  rw [Finset.sum_mul]
    44	  simp_rw [Finset.mul_sum, heteroKron_mul]
    45	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    46	  intro outcome _
    47	  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single outcome]
    48	  · rw [(hprojective outcome).isIdempotentElem.eq]
    49	  · intro other _ hother
    50	    rw [DistanceCalculus.projective_effect_mul_effect_eq_zero
    51	      measurement hprojective hother.symm]
    52	    exact Matrix.zero_kronecker _
    53	  · simp
    54	
    55	variable [DecidableEq Target]
    56	
    57	/-- A controlled operator times its adjoint is the identity when each component
    58	times its adjoint is the identity. This is the finite controlled-unitary
    59	calculation at paper `14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1687-1700`,
    60	with arbitrary unitary components in place of the products of Pauli observables. -/
    61	theorem sum_heteroKron_mul_conjTranspose
    62	    (measurement : Measurement Outcome Control)
    63	    (hprojective : MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective measurement)
    64	    (operators : Outcome → Op Target)
    65	    (hunitary : ∀ outcome, operators outcome * (operators outcome)ᴴ = 1) :
    66	    (∑ outcome, heteroKron (measurement.effect outcome) (operators outcome)) *
    67	        (∑ outcome, heteroKron (measurement.effect outcome) (operators outcome))ᴴ = 1 := by
    68	  have hself (outcome : Outcome) :
    69	      (measurement.effect outcome)ᴴ = measurement.effect outcome :=
    70	    (hprojective outcome).isSelfAdjoint.star_eq
    71	  calc
    72	    _ = (∑ outcome, heteroKron (measurement.effect outcome) (operators outcome)) *
    73	        (∑ outcome, heteroKron (measurement.effect outcome) ((operators outcome)ᴴ)) := by
    74	      simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_sum, heteroKron, Matrix.kronecker,
    75	        Matrix.conjTranspose_kronecker, hself]
    76	    _ = ∑ outcome, heteroKron (measurement.effect outcome)
    77	        (operators outcome * (operators outcome)ᴴ) :=
    78	      sum_heteroKron_mul_sum_heteroKron measurement hprojective _ _
    79	    _ = ∑ outcome, heteroKron (measurement.effect outcome) (1 : Op Target) := by
    80	      simp_rw [hunitary]
    81	    _ = 1 := by
    82	      rw [← DistanceCalculus.heteroKron_finset_sum_left, measurement.sum_eq_one,
    83	        heteroKron_one_one]
    84	
    85	/-- The reverse adjoint product of a controlled operator is also the identity.
    86	For finite square matrices, Mathlib's `mul_eq_one_comm` converts either inverse
    87	identity to the other, both for the components and for the controlled operator.
    88	This supplies the reverse identity implicit in the same source calculation. -/
    89	theorem conjTranspose_mul_sum_heteroKron
    90	    (measurement : Measurement Outcome Control)
    91	    (hprojective : MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective measurement)
    92	    (operators : Outcome → Op Target)
    93	    (hunitary : ∀ outcome, (operators outcome)ᴴ * operators outcome = 1) :
    94	    (∑ outcome, heteroKron (measurement.effect outcome) (operators outcome))ᴴ *
    95	        (∑ outcome, heteroKron (measurement.effect outcome) (operators outcome)) = 1 := by
    96	  apply mul_eq_one_comm.mp
    97	  apply sum_heteroKron_mul_conjTranspose measurement hprojective operators
    98	  intro outcome
    99	  exact mul_eq_one_comm.mp (hunitary outcome)
   100	
   101	/-- A finite sum of unitary operators controlled by a complete projective
   102	measurement is unitary. The hypotheses concern the actual component operators;
   103	no unitarity or extraction conclusion is assumed for their controlled sum. -/
   104	theorem sum_heteroKron_mem_unitary
   105	    (measurement : Measurement Outcome Control)
   106	    (hprojective : MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective measurement)
   107	    (operators : Outcome → Op Target)
   108	    (hunitary : ∀ outcome, operators outcome ∈ unitary (Op Target)) :
   109	    (∑ outcome, heteroKron (measurement.effect outcome) (operators outcome)) ∈
   110	      unitary (Op (Control × Target)) := by
   111	  exact ⟨conjTranspose_mul_sum_heteroKron measurement hprojective operators
   112	      (fun outcome => (hunitary outcome).1),
   113	    sum_heteroKron_mul_conjTranspose measurement hprojective operators
   114	      (fun outcome => (hunitary outcome).2)⟩
   115	
   116	end MIPStarRE.Quantum

     3	/-!
     4	# Extraction foundations
     5	
     6	This module defines the register identifications used to pull the Pauli
     7	measurements apart. It retains the distinct local spaces of a
     8	heterogeneous strategy, coarse-grains the generalized Pauli projectors by a
     9	dot product, and records the state and error expressions needed by the later
    10	extraction witness.
    11	
    12	The binary phases use the existing `phaseSign`; the fixed field basis remains
    13	the basis stored in `P.model` and is not re-quantified here.
    14	
    15	## References
    16	
    17	The Pauli dot-product projectors formalize blueprint
    18	`def:tau-dot-product-projector`, from
    19	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1426-1429`.
    20	The register and state helpers support blueprint `def:tilde-m-measurement`,
    21	`def:v-swap-unitary`, and `lem:qld-unitary`, from paper lines 1429-1435 and
    22	1666-1713.
    23	-/
    24	
    25	open scoped BigOperators Matrix
    26	
    27	namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
    28	
    29	open MIPStarRE.Quantum
    30	
    31	noncomputable section
    32	
    33	/-! ## Heterogeneous extraction registers -/
    34	
    35	/-- One player's registers after adjoining the two generalized-Pauli
    36	registers: `AA'A''` or `BB'B''`. This identifies the register order and spaces for
    37	paper `14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1429-1435,1687-1713` and
    38	blueprint `def:tilde-m-measurement` and `def:v-swap-unitary`. -/
    39	abbrev ExtractionBlock (P : AdmissibleParams) (ι : Type*) :=
    40	  (ι × PauliRegister P) × PauliRegister P
    41	
    42	/-- The two heterogeneous extraction blocks in the order
    43	`AA'A'' | BB'B''`. This is the block presentation of the existing `SixReg`
    44	space used in blueprint
    45	`lem:qld-unitary`, paper
    46	`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1666-1685`. -/
    47	abbrev ExtractionRegisters (P : AdmissibleParams) (ιA ιB : Type*) :=
    48	  ExtractionBlock P ιA × ExtractionBlock P ιB
    49	
    50	/-- The auxiliary registers `AA'BB'` occurring before the extracted EPR
    51	factor in blueprint `lem:qld-unitary`,
    52	paper `14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1666-1685`. -/
    53	abbrev ExtractionAuxRegisters (P : AdmissibleParams) (ιA ιB : Type*) :=
    54	  (ιA × PauliRegister P) × (ιB × PauliRegister P)
    55	
    56	/-- Reassociate the six-register order with the two extraction blocks.
    57	This equivalence identifies the register order in paper
    58	`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1429-1435,1687-1713`. -/
    59	def sixRegExtractionEquiv (P : AdmissibleParams) (ιA ιB : Type*) :
    60	    SixReg P ιA ιB ≃ ExtractionRegisters P ιA ιB where
    61	  toFun p := (((p.1.1, p.1.2.1), p.1.2.2),
    62	    ((p.2.1, p.2.2.1), p.2.2.2))
    63	  invFun p := ((p.1.1.1, (p.1.1.2, p.1.2)),
    64	    (p.2.1.1, (p.2.1.2, p.2.2)))
    65	  left_inv p := by cases p; rfl
    66	  right_inv p := by cases p; rfl
    67	
    68	/-- Shuffle `AA'BB' | A''B''` into the six-register order. This equivalence
    69	places the ideal state in the order used in blueprint
    70	`lem:qld-unitary`, paper
    71	`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1666-1685`. -/
    72	def extractionIdealShuffle (P : AdmissibleParams) (ιA ιB : Type*) :
    73	    (ExtractionAuxRegisters P ιA ιB ×
    74	      (PauliRegister P × PauliRegister P)) ≃ SixReg P ιA ιB where
    75	  toFun p := ((p.1.1.1, (p.1.1.2, p.2.1)),
    76	    (p.1.2.1, (p.1.2.2, p.2.2)))
    77	  invFun p := (((p.1.1, p.1.2.1), (p.2.1, p.2.2.1)),
    78	    (p.1.2.2, p.2.2.2))
    79	  left_inv p := by cases p; rfl
    80	  right_inv p := by cases p; rfl
    81	
    82	namespace ProjectiveSetting
    83	
    84	variable {P : AdmissibleParams} {ε : ℝ}
    85	
    86	/-- Place an operator on one complete extraction block, with the identity on
    87	the other player's block, as in the side-qualified operators of paper
    88	`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1429-1435,1687-1713`. -/
    89	noncomputable def placeSide (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε) (side : PlayerSide)
    90	    (O : Op (ExtractionBlock P (S.LocalSpace side))) :
    91	    Op (SixReg P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB) := by
    92	  cases side with
    93	  | alice =>
    94	      exact reindexOp
    95	        (sixRegExtractionEquiv P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)
    96	        (heteroKron O 1)
    97	  | bob =>
    98	      exact reindexOp
    99	        (sixRegExtractionEquiv P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)
   100	        (heteroKron 1 O)
   101	
   102	/-- Lift an operator on a player's original strategy register to that player's
   103	full extraction block. This places the Pauli and point measurements appearing
   104	in blueprint `lem:qld-construct-the-paulis` and `lem:qld-unitary`. -/
   105	noncomputable def onPlayer (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε) (side : PlayerSide)
   106	    (O : Op (S.LocalSpace side)) :
   107	    Op (ExtractionBlock P (S.LocalSpace side)) :=
   108	  heteroKron (heteroKron O 1) 1
   109	
   110	/-- Place an operator on the original strategy register of the selected
   111	player. This is the player-side placement used in blueprint
   112	`lem:qld-unitary`. -/
   113	noncomputable def placePlayer (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε) (side : PlayerSide)
   114	    (O : Op (S.LocalSpace side)) :
   115	    Op (SixReg P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB) := by
   116	  cases side with
   117	  | alice => exact S.place .AA' (heteroKron O 1)
   118	  | bob => exact S.place .BB' (heteroKron O 1)
   119	
   120	/-- Place an operator on the selected extracted register `A''` or `B''`.
   121	The unused strategy register in the crossed placement is assigned the
   122	identity. This is the placement of the ideal Pauli operators in
   123	blueprint `lem:qld-unitary`, paper
   124	`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1666-1685`. -/
   125	noncomputable def placeExtractedRegister (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε)
   126	    (side : PlayerSide) (O : Op (PauliRegister P)) :
   127	    Op (SixReg P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB) := by
   128	  cases side with
   129	  | alice =>
   130	      exact S.place .BA'' (heteroKron (1 : Op S.toStrategy.ιB) O)
   131	  | bob =>
   132	      exact S.place .AB'' (heteroKron (1 : Op S.toStrategy.ιA) O)
   133	
   134	/-- Place a pair of block operators simultaneously on `AA'A''` and
   135	`BB'B''`. This is the simultaneous placement used for the transformed state in
   136	blueprint `lem:qld-unitary`, paper
   137	`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1666-1685`. -/
   138	noncomputable def placeBoth (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε)
   139	    (VA : Op (ExtractionBlock P S.toStrategy.ιA))
   140	    (VB : Op (ExtractionBlock P S.toStrategy.ιB)) :
   141	    Op (SixReg P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB) :=
   142	  reindexOp (sixRegExtractionEquiv P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)
   143	    (heteroKron VA VB)
   144	
   145	/-- Apply one operator to each heterogeneous extraction block. This is the
   146	witness-independent state transformation used for `V_A tensor V_B` in
   147	blueprint `lem:qld-unitary`, paper
   148	`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1666-1685`. -/
   149	noncomputable def applyBoth (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε)
   150	    (VA : Op (ExtractionBlock P S.toStrategy.ιA))
   151	    (VB : Op (ExtractionBlock P S.toStrategy.ιB))
   152	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ
   153	      (SixReg P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)) :
   154	    EuclideanSpace ℂ (SixReg P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB) :=
   155	  applyOperatorToState (S.placeBoth VA VB) ψ
   156	
   157	/-- The state `aux tensor EPR_q^{tensor M}` in the six-register order.
   158	This is the ideal state in Item 1 of blueprint
   159	`lem:qld-unitary`, paper
   160	`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1666-1685`. -/
   161	noncomputable def idealExpState (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε)
   162	    (aux : EuclideanSpace ℂ
   163	      (ExtractionAuxRegisters P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)) :
   164	    EuclideanSpace ℂ (SixReg P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB) := by
   165	  classical
   166	  exact
   167	    reindexState (extractionIdealShuffle P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)
   168	      (vecTensor aux (eprState (PauliRegister P)))
   169	
   170	end ProjectiveSetting
   171	
   172	/-! ## Coarse-grained Pauli projectors -/
   173	
   174	/-- Coarse-grain a finite operator family along a map of outcomes. This is the
   175	operator-valued sum corresponding to `Measurement.postprocess`, used by
   176	blueprint
   177	`def:tau-dot-product-projector`. -/
   178	noncomputable def bracketOp {α β ι : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq β]
   179	    (N : α → Op ι) (f : α → β) (b : β) : Op ι :=
   180	  ∑ a ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun a => f a = b), N a
   181	
   182	/-- The effect of a postprocessed measurement is the corresponding
   183	coarse-grained operator sum. This equality is used by blueprint `def:bracket`
   184	and `def:tau-dot-product-projector`. -/
   185	theorem postprocess_effect_eq_bracketOp {α β ι : Type*}
   186	    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β]
   187	    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (M : Measurement α ι) (f : α → β) (b : β) :
   188	    (M.postprocess f).effect b = bracketOp M.effect f b :=
   189	  rfl
   190	
   191	/-- The projector obtained by measuring in basis `W` and retaining outcomes
   192	whose dot product with `u` is `a`. This is Equation `eq:def-tauwu` in
   193	blueprint
   194	`def:tau-dot-product-projector`, paper
   195	`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1426-1429`. -/
   196	noncomputable def tauDotProj {P : AdmissibleParams} (W : PauliKind)
   197	    (u : PauliRegister P) (a : PauliScalar P) : Op (PauliRegister P) :=
   198	  bracketOp (pauliProj W) (fun h => dotProduct h u) a
   199	
   200	/-- Each dot-product coarse-graining is a projector, as asserted in
   201	blueprint
   202	`lem:tau-dot-product-projective`, paper
   203	`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1426-1429`.
   204	
   205	Completeness makes the matrix of Pauli basis vectors unitary. The coarse-grained
   206	operator is the conjugate of the diagonal projector onto the specified outcomes. -/
   207	theorem tauDotProj_isProj {P : AdmissibleParams} (W : PauliKind)
   208	    (u : PauliRegister P) (a : PauliScalar P) :
   209	    IsProj (tauDotProj W u a) := by
   210	  classical
   211	  let basisMatrix : Op (PauliRegister P) := fun row label => pauliVec W label row
   212	  have hbasis : basisMatrix * basisMatrixᴴ = 1 := by
   213	    calc
   214	      basisMatrix * basisMatrixᴴ = ∑ label : PauliRegister P, pauliProj W label := by
   215	        ext row column
   216	        simp [basisMatrix, Matrix.mul_apply, pauliProj, Matrix.sum_apply,
   217	          Matrix.vecMulVec_apply]
   218	      _ = 1 := sum_pauliProj_eq_one W
   219	  let diagonalProj : Op (PauliRegister P) :=
   220	    Matrix.diagonal (fun label => if dotProduct label u = a then (1 : ℂ) else 0)
   221	  have hdiagonal : IsProj diagonalProj := by
   222	    constructor
   223	    · change Matrix.diagonal _ * Matrix.diagonal _ = Matrix.diagonal _
   224	      rw [Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal]
   225	      congr 1
   226	      funext label
   227	      split_ifs <;> simp
   228	    · change diagonalProjᴴ = diagonalProj
   229	      simp [diagonalProj, Matrix.diagonal_conjTranspose]
   230	  have hcoarse : tauDotProj W u a = basisMatrix * diagonalProj * basisMatrixᴴ := by
   231	    ext row column
   232	    simp only [tauDotProj, bracketOp, Matrix.sum_apply, pauliProj, Matrix.vecMulVec_apply]
   233	    rw [Matrix.mul_apply]
   234	    simp only [diagonalProj, Matrix.mul_diagonal]
   235	    simp [basisMatrix, Finset.sum_filter, mul_ite, ite_mul]
   236	  rw [hcoarse]
   237	  exact hdiagonal.map (Unitary.conjStarAlgAut ℂ (Op (PauliRegister P))
   238	    ⟨basisMatrix, Matrix.mem_unitaryGroup_iff.mpr hbasis⟩)
   239	
   240	/-- For fixed `W` and `u`, the dot-product projectors sum to the identity.
   241	This is the completeness assertion of blueprint
   242	`lem:tau-dot-product-projective`, paper
   243	`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1426-1429`.
   244	
   245	The dot-product fibers partition the complete Pauli outcome family. -/
   246	theorem sum_tauDotProj_eq_one {P : AdmissibleParams} (W : PauliKind)
   247	    (u : PauliRegister P) :
   248	    ∑ a : PauliScalar P, tauDotProj W u a = 1 := by
   249	  classical
   250	  unfold tauDotProj bracketOp

   257	This formalization-only companion follows from projectivity and completeness

   260	theorem tauDotProj_mul_eq_zero_of_ne {P : AdmissibleParams} (W : PauliKind)

   271	/-- Conjugation of an operator by a square matrix, as used in the exact
   272	conjugation equations in blueprint
   273	`lem:v-swap-conjugation`, paper
   274	`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1687-1713`. -/

   279	/-- The common error scale for constructing the pulled-apart measurements from
   280	a global polynomial-pair witness. Here `deltaG` is its consistency error. The
   281	remaining terms record the point-measurement transfer
   282	and the Schwartz--Zippel loss; when `0 ≤ epsilon ≤ 1`, `sqrt epsilon` also
   283	dominates terms of order `epsilon`.

   285	This makes explicit the enlargement of the error called `deltaS` in
   286	blueprint
   287	`lem:qld-construct-the-paulis`, paper
   288	`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1458-1605`. -/
   289	noncomputable def deltaConstructPaulis (C epsilon deltaG : ℝ)
   290	    (m d q : ℕ) : ℝ :=
   291	  C * (deltaG + Real.sqrt epsilon +
   292	    ((m * d : ℕ) : ℝ) / (q : ℝ))

   296	`lem:qld-unitary`, paper
   297	`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1666-1685`. -/
   298	noncomputable def deltaExtract (C deltaS : ℝ) (m d q : ℕ) : ℝ :=
   299	  C * (Real.rpow deltaS (1 / 4 : ℝ) + ((m * d : ℕ) : ℝ) / (q : ℝ))

    10	This module defines the five measurement and distribution witnesses used in
    11	the combining argument.  Every measurement is indexed by the player side, so
    12	Alice's and Bob's local spaces remain distinct.  The extended-dimensional
    13	line objects use the directly indexed low-degree interface and therefore do

    21	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch15_qpbt_combining.tex`.  `SubLineWitness` and
    22	`ExtendedLinesWitness` instead support `lem:qld-sublines` and `lem:qld-4-13`
    23	through the directly indexed extended-line carrier and probability law.  The
    24	latter also uses the completed answer alphabet, rather than the field-valued

   134	
   135	/-- A tuple consisting of an extended line and its projected X and Z lines. -/
   136	abbrev SubLineTriple (P : AdmissibleParams) :=
   137	  DirectLineDesc P.extendedDirectLd ×
   138	    (LineDesc P.toLdParams × LineDesc P.toLdParams)
   139	
   140	/-- An extended line tuple together with a point sampled uniformly on it. -/
   141	abbrev SubLinePointSample (P : AdmissibleParams) :=
   142	  SubLineTriple P ×
   143	    (Fin P.extendedDirectLd.m -> DirectScalarQ P.extendedDirectLd)
   144	
   145	/-- The shared restricted line kind and two coordinate indices in one mixture
   146	component of the subline law. -/
   147	abbrev SubLineComponent (P : AdmissibleParams) :=
   148	  LineKind × (Fin P.m × Fin P.m)
   149	
   150	/-- Select the restricted line-point distribution of a given kind and index. -/
   151	noncomputable def restrictedLinePointDist (P : AdmissibleParams)
   152	    (kind : LineKind) (i : Fin P.m) :
   153	    Distribution (LineDesc P.toLdParams × (Fin P.m -> PauliScalar P)) :=
   154	  match kind with
   155	  | .axis => restrictedALineDist P.toLdParams i
   156	  | .diagonal => restrictedDLineDist P.toLdParams i

   158	/-- Sample a subline tuple and then a uniform affine parameter on its
   159	extended line. -/
   160	noncomputable def subLinePointDist (P : AdmissibleParams)
   161	    (D : Distribution (SubLineTriple P)) :
   162	    Distribution (SubLinePointSample P) :=
   163	  (Distribution.prod D
   164	    (uniformDistribution (DirectScalarQ P.extendedDirectLd))).map fun sample =>
   165	      (sample.1, sample.1.1.base + sample.2 • sample.1.1.direction)

   167	/-- Retain the projected line pair and the X projection of an extended point. -/
   168	def subLineXProjection {P : AdmissibleParams} (sample : SubLinePointSample P) :
   169	    (LineDesc P.toLdParams × LineDesc P.toLdParams) ×
   170	      (Fin P.m -> PauliScalar P) :=

   173	/-- Retain the projected line pair and the Z projection of an extended point. -/
   174	def subLineZProjection {P : AdmissibleParams} (sample : SubLinePointSample P) :
   175	    (LineDesc P.toLdParams × LineDesc P.toLdParams) ×
   176	      (Fin P.m -> PauliScalar P) :=

   178	
   179	/-- The X-point marginal associated with one restricted product component. -/
   180	noncomputable def subLineXComponentDist (P : AdmissibleParams)
   181	    (component : SubLineComponent P) :
   182	    Distribution
   183	      ((LineDesc P.toLdParams × LineDesc P.toLdParams) ×
   184	        (Fin P.m -> PauliScalar P)) :=
   185	  (Distribution.prod
   186	    (restrictedLinePointDist P component.1 component.2.1)
   187	    ((restrictedLinePointDist P component.1 component.2.2).map Prod.fst)).map
   188	      fun sample => ((sample.1.1, sample.2), sample.1.2)
   189	
   190	/-- The Z-point marginal associated with one restricted product component. -/
   191	noncomputable def subLineZComponentDist (P : AdmissibleParams)
   192	    (component : SubLineComponent P) :
   193	    Distribution
   194	      ((LineDesc P.toLdParams × LineDesc P.toLdParams) ×
   195	        (Fin P.m -> PauliScalar P)) :=

   197	    ((restrictedLinePointDist P component.1 component.2.1).map Prod.fst)
   198	    (restrictedLinePointDist P component.1 component.2.2)).map
   199	      fun sample => ((sample.1, sample.2.1), sample.2.2)

   201	/-- Directly indexed form of the subline distribution of `lem:qld-sublines`,
   202	paper lines 1063--1069.  Its extended-line marginal is the directly indexed
   203	line-point law rather than the seed-indexed line-point distribution over
   204	`F_q^(2m+2)` of the source statement; that replacement is documented in

   206	formalization auxiliary record, not the source-labelled statement.  Its

   209	structure SubLineWitness (P : AdmissibleParams) where
   210	  /-- The actual distribution of an extended line and two projected lines. -/
   211	  D : Distribution (SubLineTriple P)
   212	  /-- The distribution has total mass one. -/
   213	  isProbability : D.IsProbability
   214	  /-- Its extended-line marginal is the direct line-point marginal. -/
   215	  extended_marginal : D.map Prod.fst =
   216	    (directLinePointDist P.extendedDirectLd).map Prod.fst
   217	  /-- Every point of an extended line projects onto both stored source lines. -/
   218	  incidence : ∀ sample ∈ D.support, ∀ u ∈ sample.1.pointSet,
   219	    projX (directPointToPauli P u) ∈ sample.2.1.pointSet ∧
   220	      projZ (directPointToPauli P u) ∈ sample.2.2.pointSet
   221	  /-- Each line triple carries affine data sufficient for

   224	    ∃ aX bX aZ bZ uAlpha vAlpha uBeta vBeta : PauliScalar P,

   229	        sample.2.2.base sample.2.2.direction
   230	        aX bX aZ bZ uAlpha vAlpha uBeta vBeta

   237	      (subLinePointDist P D).map subLineZProjection =
   238	        Distribution.bind components (subLineZComponentDist P)

   240	  axis_closure : ∀ sample ∈ D.support, sample.1.kind = .axis ->

1678		\item For all $W \in \{X,Z\}, h \in \F_q^\nqubits$
  1679		\begin{align*}
  1680			V_\alice \, \Big(M^{(\Pauli,W)}_h \Big)_{\alice} \, V_\alice^\dagger &\approx_{\delta_\qld} \Id_{\alice \alice'} \otimes (\tau^W_h)_{\alice''} \\
  1681			 V_\bob \, \Big(M^{(\Pauli,W)}_h  \Big)_{\bob}\, V_\bob^\dagger &\approx_{\delta_\qld} \Id_{\bob \bob'} \otimes (\tau^W_h)_{\bob''}
  1682		\end{align*}
  1683		where the $\approx$ statements hold with respect to the state $\ket{\aux}_{\alice \alice' \bob \bob'} \otimes \ket{\EPR_q}^{\otimes \nqubits}_{\alice'' \bob''}$. 
  1684	\end{enumerate}
  1685	\end{lemma}
  1686	
  1687	\begin{proof}
  1688	
  1689	Define the linear map
  1690	\[
  1691		V_\alice = \sum_{g_X,g_Z} (\hat{S}_{g_X,g_Z})_{\alice \alice'} \otimes (\tau^X(\coded(g_Z)) \tau^Z(\coded(g_X)))_{\alice ''}\;,
  1692	\]
  1693	where the $\tau^X(\cdot),\tau^Z(\cdot)$ act on $(\C^q)^{\otimes \nqubits}$. (Also note that the argument of $\tau^X$ is $\coded(g_Z)$ and the argument of $\tau^Z$ is $\coded(g_X)$.) We verify the unitarity of $V_\alice$:
  1694	\begin{align*}
  1695		V_\alice V_\alice^\dagger &= \sum_{g_X,g_Z} (\hat{S}_{g_X,g_Z})_{\alice \alice'} \otimes (\tau^X(\coded(g_Z)) \tau^Z(\coded(g_X)) \tau^Z(\coded(g_X)) \tau^X(\coded(g_Z)) )_{\alice ''} \\
  1696		&= \sum_{g_X,g_Z} (\hat{S}_{g_X,g_Z})_{\alice \alice'} \otimes \Id_{\alice ''} \\
  1697		&= \Id_{\alice \alice' \alice''}
  1698	\end{align*}
  1699	where in the first line we used that the measurement $\{ \hat{S}_{g_\xpt,g_\zpt} \}$  is projective and in the second line we used that the $\tau^Z$ and $\tau^X$ observables are self-inverse. The unitary $V_\bob$ is defined analogously.
  1700	
  1701	Let $\{e_j\}_{j \in \{1,\ldots,t\}}$ denote the self-dual basis for $\F_q$ over $\F_2$ specified in \Cref{sec:subfields}, and let $\tilde{W}^j$ be the observables introduced in~\eqref{eq:def-tildewj}. Conjugating the observable $\tilde{W}^j$ acting on the registers $\alice \alice' \alice''$ by the unitary $V_\alice$ we get

   158	requires composing \path{exists_globalPairWitness} with this helper to obtain
   159	the source lemma; no declaration carries out that composition.
   160	
   161	Issue~\#19 owns this concrete Stage~4.2 interface and discrepancy record.
   162	\ghissue{123} owns the source-facing composition through
   163	\path{exists_globalPairWitness}.  \ghissue{47} tracks the separate
   164	range-projection transfer needed by \path{pauli_soundness}; that theorem must
   165	be derived from the concrete data rather than stored in the witness.
   166	
   167	\section{Conclusion}
   168	
   169	The printed triangle calculation has repairable numerical errors, and the
   170	last passage from unitaries to isometries omits a genuine range-projection
   171	argument.  Neither defect is a counterexample to Pauli soundness.  The former
   172	is corrected by positive-contraction inequalities and a small-error split;
   173	the latter remains a named downstream proof obligation whose hypotheses are
   174	already supplied by the extraction lemma.  Independently of both defects, the
   175	present extraction declaration is conditional on the global polynomial-pair
   176	measurement, and that conditionality must be removed before it may be
