     5	/-! # Encoding-supported Pauli reference measurements
     6	
     7	The reference measurement measures the strategy's Pauli answer and an independent
     8	ideal Pauli answer, then returns the bounded encoding of their sum. Its effects
     9	vanish outside the encoding image. Evaluation of its polynomial outcome is the
    10	convolution of the evaluated strategy measurement and the ideal point projectors.
    11	
    12	These are internal auxiliary constructions for blueprint `eq:qld-nonencoding-mass`
    13	and `lem:qld-nonencoding-mass-bound`, not the quantitative support estimate. No
    14	winning premise or global polynomial-pair witness is used or constructed here.
    15	
    16	## References
    17	
    18	The encoding is paper `eq:low-degree-encoding-definition` in
    19	`references/qpbt-paper/04_preliminaries.tex:882-897`. The convolution is the Pauli
    20	answer replacement of the expanded point measurement at
    21	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:383-418`.
    22	The corrected use in `lem:qld-construct-the-paulis` is recorded in blueprint
    23	`eq:qld-nonencoding-mass` and `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_decoding-identity.tex`.
    24	-/
    25	
    26	open scoped BigOperators Matrix MatrixOrder ComplexOrder
    27	
    28	namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
    29	
    30	open MIPStarRE.Quantum
    31	
    32	variable {params : AdmissibleParams} {error : ℝ}
    33	
    34	/-- The ideal Pauli basis measurement on the ancillary register, bundled using
    35	positivity and completeness of the existing Pauli projectors. -/
    36	noncomputable def pauliRegisterMeas (basis : PauliKind) :
    37	    Measurement (PauliRegister params) (PauliRegister params) :=
    38	  Measurement.ofSumEqOne (pauliProj basis)
    39	    (fun answer => Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mpr (posSemidef_pauliProj basis answer))
    40	    (sum_pauliProj_eq_one basis)
    41	
    42	/-- Every bounded encoding lies in the full-field decoder's encoding image. -/
    43	@[simp] theorem isEncoding_encodingPoly (answer : PauliRegister params) :
    44	    IsEncoding (encodingPoly answer) := by
    45	  unfold IsEncoding
    46	  rw [decodeFq_lowDegreeEncoding]
    47	  rfl
    48	
    49	namespace ProjectiveSetting
    50	
    51	/-- Measure the strategy Pauli answer and the ancillary ideal Pauli answer and
    52	return the encoding of their sum. This complete POVM is the internal reference
    53	measurement underlying blueprint `eq:qld-nonencoding-mass`; it is not the global
    54	polynomial measurement whose existence is required in `lem:qld-4-7`. -/
    55	noncomputable def encodingPauliMeas (setting : ProjectiveSetting params error)
    56	    (side : PlayerSide) (basis : PauliKind) :
    57	    Measurement (Poly params) (setting.ExpandedLocalSpace side) :=
    58	  (tensorMeasurement (setting.pauliMeas side basis) (pauliRegisterMeas basis)).postprocess
    59	    fun answers => encodingPoly (answers.1 + answers.2)
    60	
    61	/-- The reference effect sums the product effects over pairs whose sum encodes
    62	the specified polynomial representative. -/
    63	theorem encodingPauliMeas_effect (setting : ProjectiveSetting params error)
    64	    (side : PlayerSide) (basis : PauliKind) (poly : Poly params) :
    65	    (setting.encodingPauliMeas side basis).effect poly =
    66	      ∑ answers ∈ Finset.univ.filter
    67	          (fun answers : PauliRegister params × PauliRegister params =>
    68	            encodingPoly (answers.1 + answers.2) = poly),
    69	        heteroKron ((setting.pauliMeas side basis).effect answers.1)
    70	          (pauliProj basis answers.2) :=
    71	  rfl
    72	
    73	/-- Positivity is preserved by the tensor product and the encoding postprocessing. -/
    74	theorem encodingPauliMeas_effect_nonneg (setting : ProjectiveSetting params error)
    75	    (side : PlayerSide) (basis : PauliKind) (poly : Poly params) :
    76	    0 ≤ (setting.encodingPauliMeas side basis).effect poly :=
    77	  (setting.encodingPauliMeas side basis).pos poly
    78	
    79	/-- The reference effects sum to the identity on the strategy and ancillary registers. -/
    80	theorem sum_encodingPauliMeas_effect_eq_one (setting : ProjectiveSetting params error)
    81	    (side : PlayerSide) (basis : PauliKind) :
    82	    ∑ poly, (setting.encodingPauliMeas side basis).effect poly = 1 :=
    83	  (setting.encodingPauliMeas side basis).sum_eq_one
    84	
    85	/-- A nonencoding polynomial has zero reference effect. This is exact support of
    86	the auxiliary measurement, not a bound on the global polynomial measurement. -/
    87	theorem encodingPauliMeas_effect_eq_zero_of_not_isEncoding
    88	    (setting : ProjectiveSetting params error) (side : PlayerSide) (basis : PauliKind)
    89	    (poly : Poly params) (hpoly : ¬ IsEncoding poly) :
    90	    (setting.encodingPauliMeas side basis).effect poly = 0 := by
    91	  classical
    92	  rw [encodingPauliMeas_effect]
    93	  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    94	  intro answers hanswers
    95	  exact False.elim (hpoly ((Finset.mem_filter.mp hanswers).2 ▸
    96	    isEncoding_encodingPoly (answers.1 + answers.2)))
    97	
    98	/-- Evaluating the reference polynomial is equivalent to evaluating the two Pauli
    99	answers separately and adding their values. This uses linearity of the encoding,
   100	not the decoder/evaluation identity for arbitrary polynomial representatives. -/
   101	theorem encodingPauliMeas_postprocess_eval (setting : ProjectiveSetting params error)
   102	    (side : PlayerSide) (basis : PauliKind) (point : Fin params.m → PauliScalar params) :
   103	    (setting.encodingPauliMeas side basis).postprocess (fun poly => evalPoly poly point) =
   104	      (tensorMeasurement (setting.pauliEvalMeas side basis point)
   105	        ((pauliRegisterMeas basis).postprocess
   106	          (fun answer => lowDegreeEnc answer point))).postprocess
   107	        (fun values => values.1 + values.2) := by
   108	  unfold encodingPauliMeas pauliEvalMeas
   109	  rw [Measurement.postprocess_comp, tensorMeasurement_postprocess,
   110	    Measurement.postprocess_comp]
   111	  apply congrArg ((tensorMeasurement (setting.pauliMeas side basis)
   112	    (pauliRegisterMeas basis)).postprocess)
   113	  funext answers
   114	  change lowDegreeEnc (answers.1 + answers.2) point =
   115	    lowDegreeEnc answers.1 point + lowDegreeEnc answers.2 point
   116	  simp only [lowDegreeEnc_eq_dotProduct, add_dotProduct]
   117	
   118	/-- The evaluated reference effects are exactly the Pauli-answer convolution
   119	`K^u_a` in the proof of blueprint `eq:qld-nonencoding-mass`. This identity makes no
   120	approximation or assertion of consistency with the strategy's point measurement. -/
   121	theorem encodingPauliMeas_eval_effect_eq_convolution
   122	    (setting : ProjectiveSetting params error) (side : PlayerSide) (basis : PauliKind)
   123	    (point : Fin params.m → PauliScalar params) (value : PauliScalar params) :
   124	    ((setting.encodingPauliMeas side basis).postprocess
   125	      (fun poly => evalPoly poly point)).effect value =
   126	      ∑ values ∈ Finset.univ.filter
   127	          (fun values : PauliScalar params × PauliScalar params => values.1 + values.2 = value),
   128	        heteroKron ((setting.pauliEvalMeas side basis point).effect values.1)
   129	          (tauPointProj basis point values.2) := by
   130	  rw [encodingPauliMeas_postprocess_eval, Measurement.postprocess_effect]
   131	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   132	  intro values _
   133	  change heteroKron ((setting.pauliEvalMeas side basis point).effect values.1)
   134	    (((pauliRegisterMeas basis).postprocess
   135	      (fun answer => lowDegreeEnc answer point)).effect values.2) = _
   136	  simp only [Measurement.postprocess_effect, lowDegreeEnc_eq_dotProduct]
   137	  rfl
   138	
   139	end ProjectiveSetting
   140	
   141	end MIPStarRE.QPBT

     5	/-!
     6	# Point consistency after decoding polynomial outcomes
     7	
     8	This module expands the overlap of an original point measurement with a
     9	pulled-apart measurement. The decoded polynomial is kept explicit, so the
    10	calculation does not use the decoder identity outside the encoding image.
    11	
    12	## References
    13	
    14	These are auxiliary identities for blueprint `lem:qld-construct-the-paulis`,
    15	paper `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1483-1492`.
    16	The restriction on the decoder identity is recorded in
    17	`docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_decoding-identity.tex`.
    18	-/
    19	
    20	open scoped BigOperators Matrix MatrixOrder ComplexOrder
    21	
    22	namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

    32	
    33	/-- Placing a tensor with an identity on Bob's last register recovers `BB'`. -/
    34	theorem placeSide_bob_tensor_one (S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon)
    35	    (B : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace .bob)) :
    36	    S.placeSide .bob (heteroKron B (1 : Op (PauliRegister P))) = S.place .BB' B := by
    37	  ext row col
    38	  simp [placeSide, sixRegExtractionEquiv, reindexOp, heteroKron, Matrix.kronecker,
    39	    place, Matrix.one_apply, Prod.ext_iff, ite_and, mul_ite, ite_mul]
    40	  split_ifs <;> rfl
    41	
    42	/-- The point factor on `A` and the factors on `BB'B''` can be regrouped as
    43	the factors on `BB'` and `AB''`, without moving any register. -/
    44	theorem placePlayer_alice_mul_placeSide_bob_tensor (S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon)
    45	    (A : Op S.toStrategy.ιA) (B : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace .bob))
    46	    (T : Op (PauliRegister P)) :
    47	    S.placePlayer .alice A * S.placeSide .bob (heteroKron B T) =
    48	      S.place .BB' B * S.place .AB'' (heteroKron A T) := by
    49	  classical
    50	  ext row col
    51	  simp [placePlayer, placeSide, sixRegExtractionEquiv, reindexOp, heteroKron,
    52	    Matrix.kronecker, place, Matrix.mul_apply, Fintype.sum_prod_type,
    53	    Matrix.one_apply, Prod.ext_iff, ite_and, mul_ite, ite_mul]
    54	  split_ifs <;> ac_rfl
    55	
    56	/-- Bob's extraction-block placement preserves finite sums. -/
    57	theorem placeSide_bob_finset_sum (S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon)
    58	    {I : Type*} (s : Finset I) (B : I → Op (ExtractionBlock P S.toStrategy.ιB)) :
    59	    S.placeSide .bob (∑ i ∈ s, B i) = ∑ i ∈ s, S.placeSide .bob (B i) := by
    60	  classical
    61	  change reindexOp (sixRegExtractionEquiv P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)
    62	    (heteroKron (1 : Op (ExtractionBlock P S.toStrategy.ιA)) (∑ i ∈ s, B i)) = _
    63	  rw [heteroKron_finset_sum_right]
    64	  ext row col
    65	  simp only [placeSide, reindexOp, Matrix.reindex_apply, Matrix.submatrix_apply,
    66	    Matrix.sum_apply]
    67	
    68	/-- The convolution formula with its second outcome solved for. This is the
    69	third line of the overlap calculation in paper lines 1483--1492. -/
    70	theorem pointMeasExp_effect_eq_sum_sub (S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon)
    71	    (side : PlayerSide) (W : PauliKind) (u : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)
    72	    (a : PauliScalar P) :
    73	    (S.pointMeasExp side W u).effect a =
    74	      ∑ b : PauliScalar P, heteroKron ((S.pointMeas side W u).effect b)
    75	        (tauDotProj W (indicatorVec u) (a - b)) := by
    76	  classical
    77	  change S.expPointOp side W u a = _
    78	  rw [S.expPointOp_eq_convolution]
    79	  simp only [Finset.sum_filter, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    80	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    81	  intro b _
    82	  have h (c : PauliScalar P) : b + c = a ↔ c = a - b := by
    83	    rw [eq_sub_iff_add_eq, add_comm]
    84	  simp only [h, Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
    85	  rfl
    86	
    87	end ProjectiveSetting
    88	
    89	/-- The original/pulled-apart overlap is exactly the expanded-point overlap
    90	at the decoded value. This is the first three lines of the proof of Item 1 in
    91	paper lines 1483--1492; it holds for every polynomial outcome. -/
    92	theorem sum_pointMeas_mul_tildeM_eq_decoded_overlap
    93	    {P : AdmissibleParams} {epsilon deltaG : ℝ} {S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon}
    94	    (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG) (W : PauliKind)
    95	    (u : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) :
    96	    (∑ a : PauliScalar P, S.placePlayer .alice ((S.pointMeas .alice W u).effect a) *
    97	      S.placeSide .bob (tildeM w .bob W (indicatorVec u) a)) =
    98	      ∑ g : Poly P, S.place .BB' ((w.marginalPoly .bob W).effect g) *
    99	        S.place .AB'' ((S.pointMeasExp .alice W u).effect
   100	          (dotProduct (decodeFq g) (indicatorVec u))) := by
   101	  classical
   102	  simp only [tildeM, S.placeSide_bob_finset_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
   103	  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
   104	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   105	  intro g _
   106	  simp only [S.placePlayer_alice_mul_placeSide_bob_tensor]
   107	  rw [← Finset.mul_sum, ← S.place_finset_sum,
   108	    S.pointMeasExp_effect_eq_sum_sub .alice W u]
   109	  rfl
   110	
   111	/-- The pulled-apart consistency defect is one minus the decoded overlap.
   112	This packages completeness with the first three lines of the source's
   113	calculation, still without imposing an encoding restriction. -/
   114	theorem tildeM_consistencyDefect_eq_one_sub_decoded_overlap
   115	    {P : AdmissibleParams} {epsilon deltaG : ℝ} {S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon}
   116	    (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG) (W : PauliKind) :
   117	    consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P))
   118	      (fun u a => S.placePlayer .alice ((S.pointMeas .alice W u).effect a))
   119	      (fun u a => S.placeSide .bob (tildeM w .bob W (indicatorVec u) a)) S.psiHat =
   120	      1 - avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)) (fun u =>
   121	        ∑ g : Poly P, stateQForm S.psiHat
   122	          (S.place .BB' ((w.marginalPoly .bob W).effect g) *
   123	            S.place .AB'' ((S.pointMeasExp .alice W u).effect
   124	              (dotProduct (decodeFq g) (indicatorVec u))))) := by
   125	  classical
   126	  let point := fun u : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P =>
   127	    S.placedMeasurement .AA' (leftPlacedMeasurement (S.pointMeas .alice W u))
   128	  let pulled : (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) → Measurement (PauliScalar P)
   129	      (SixReg P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB) := fun u =>
   130	    Measurement.ofSumEqOne
   131	      (fun a => S.placeSide .bob (tildeM w .bob W (indicatorVec u) a))
   132	      (fun a => by
   133	        apply ProjectiveSetting.reindexOp_nonneg
   134	        exact kronecker_nonneg Matrix.PosSemidef.one.nonneg
   135	          (tildeM_isProj w .bob W (indicatorVec u) a).nonneg)
   136	      (by
   137	        rw [← S.placeSide_bob_finset_sum, sum_tildeM_eq_one]
   138	        change reindexOp (sixRegExtractionEquiv P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)
   139	          (heteroKron (1 : Op (ExtractionBlock P S.toStrategy.ιA))
   140	            (1 : Op (ExtractionBlock P S.toStrategy.ιB))) = 1
   141	        rw [heteroKron_one_one]
   142	        ext row col
   143	        simp [reindexOp, Matrix.one_apply])
   144	  have h := consistencyDefect_eq_one_sub_overlap
   145	    (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)) point pulled S.psiHat
   146	    (uniformDistribution_isProbability _) S.psiHat_norm
   147	  change consistencyDefect _ _ _ S.psiHat = 1 - avgOver _ (fun u =>
   148	    ∑ a : PauliScalar P, stateQForm S.psiHat
   149	      (S.placePlayer .alice ((S.pointMeas .alice W u).effect a) *
   150	        S.placeSide .bob (tildeM w .bob W (indicatorVec u) a))) at h
   151	  refine h.trans ?_
   152	  congr 1
   153	  apply avgOver_congr
   154	  intro u
   155	  rw [← stateQForm_finset_sum, sum_pointMeas_mul_tildeM_eq_decoded_overlap,
   156	    stateQForm_finset_sum]
   157	
   158	open scoped Classical in
   159	/-- Replacing polynomial evaluation by decoded evaluation loses at most the
   160	mass of the non-encoding outcomes. This is the support-restricted replacement
   161	for the fourth line of paper lines 1483--1492. No mass estimate is assumed. -/
   162	theorem marginal_eval_overlap_le_decoded_add_nonencoding
   163	    {P : AdmissibleParams} {epsilon deltaG : ℝ} {S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon}
   164	    (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG) (W : PauliKind)
   165	    (u : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) :
   166	    (∑ g : Poly P, stateQForm S.psiHat
   167	      (S.place .BB' ((w.marginalPoly .bob W).effect g) *
   168	        S.place .AB'' ((S.pointMeasExp .alice W u).effect (MvPolynomial.eval u g.1)))) ≤
   169	      (∑ g : Poly P, stateQForm S.psiHat
   170	        (S.place .BB' ((w.marginalPoly .bob W).effect g) *
   171	          S.place .AB'' ((S.pointMeasExp .alice W u).effect
   172	            (dotProduct (decodeFq g) (indicatorVec u))))) +
   173	      ∑ g ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun g : Poly P => ¬ IsEncoding g),
   174	        stateQForm S.psiHat (S.place .BB' ((w.marginalPoly .bob W).effect g)) := by
   175	  classical
   176	  have hpos (g : Poly P) (a : PauliScalar P) :
   177	      0 ≤ stateQForm S.psiHat
   178	        (S.place .BB' ((w.marginalPoly .bob W).effect g) *
   179	          S.place .AB'' ((S.pointMeasExp .alice W u).effect a)) :=
   180	    stateQForm_nonneg _ (S.place_mul_place_nonneg .BB' .AB'' (by trivial)
   181	      ((w.marginalPoly .bob W).pos g) ((S.pointMeasExp .alice W u).pos a))
   182	  have hsum (g : Poly P) :
   183	      (∑ a : PauliScalar P, stateQForm S.psiHat
   184	        (S.place .BB' ((w.marginalPoly .bob W).effect g) *
   185	          S.place .AB'' ((S.pointMeasExp .alice W u).effect a))) =
   186	        stateQForm S.psiHat (S.place .BB' ((w.marginalPoly .bob W).effect g)) := by
   187	    have hc : (∑ a : PauliScalar P,
   188	        S.place .AB'' ((S.pointMeasExp .alice W u).effect a)) = 1 :=
   189	      (S.placedMeasurement .AB'' (S.pointMeasExp .alice W u)).sum_eq_one
   190	    rw [← stateQForm_finset_sum, ← Finset.mul_sum, hc, mul_one]
   191	  rw [Finset.sum_filter, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
   192	  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
   193	  intro g _
   194	  by_cases hg : IsEncoding g
   195	  · simp only [hg, not_true_eq_false, if_false, add_zero]
   196	    rw [decodeFq_dotProduct_indicatorVec hg u]
   197	    rfl
   198	  · simp only [hg, not_false_eq_true, if_true]
   199	    have hle := Finset.single_le_sum (fun a _ => hpos g a)
   200	      (Finset.mem_univ (MvPolynomial.eval u g.1))
   201	    rw [hsum] at hle
   202	    exact hle.trans (le_add_of_nonneg_left (hpos g _))
   203	
   204	
   205	
   206	end

   208	end MIPStarRE.QPBT

    31	/-- Placing a tensor with an identity on Alice's last register recovers `AA'`. -/

    67	
    68	/-- The Alice-pulled/Bob-point overlap is exactly the expanded-point overlap

    71	theorem sum_tildeM_mul_pointMeas_eq_decoded_overlap
    72	    {P : AdmissibleParams} {epsilon deltaG : ℝ} {S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon}
    73	    (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG) (W : PauliKind)
    74	    (u : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) :
    75	    (∑ a : PauliScalar P, S.placeSide .alice (tildeM w .alice W (indicatorVec u) a) *

    78	        S.place .BA'' ((S.pointMeasExp .bob W u).effect
    79	          (dotProduct (decodeFq g) (indicatorVec u))) := by

    81	  simp only [tildeM, S.placeSide_alice_finset_sum, Finset.sum_mul]

    83	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    84	  intro g _
    85	  simp only [S.placeSide_alice_tensor_mul_placePlayer_bob]
    86	  rw [← Finset.mul_sum, ← S.place_finset_sum,
    87	    S.pointMeasExp_effect_eq_sum_sub .bob W u]
    88	  rfl
    89	
    90	/-- The Alice-pulled/Bob-point consistency defect is one minus the decoded

    92	theorem tildeM_consistencyDefect_eq_one_sub_decoded_overlap'
    93	    {P : AdmissibleParams} {epsilon deltaG : ℝ} {S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon}

    95	    consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P))

    97	      (fun u a => S.placePlayer .bob ((S.pointMeas .bob W u).effect a)) S.psiHat =
    98	      1 - avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)) (fun u =>
    99	        ∑ g : Poly P, stateQForm S.psiHat
   100	          (S.place .AA' ((w.marginalPoly .alice W).effect g) *
   101	            S.place .BA'' ((S.pointMeasExp .bob W u).effect
   102	              (dotProduct (decodeFq g) (indicatorVec u))))) := by
   103	  classical
   104	  let point := fun u : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P =>
   105	    S.placedMeasurement .BB' (leftPlacedMeasurement (S.pointMeas .bob W u))
   106	  let pulled : (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) → Measurement (PauliScalar P)

   111	        apply ProjectiveSetting.reindexOp_nonneg
   112	        exact kronecker_nonneg (tildeM_isProj w .alice W (indicatorVec u) a).nonneg

   114	      (by
   115	        rw [← S.placeSide_alice_finset_sum, sum_tildeM_eq_one]
   116	        change reindexOp (sixRegExtractionEquiv P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)
   117	          (heteroKron (1 : Op (ExtractionBlock P S.toStrategy.ιA))
   118	            (1 : Op (ExtractionBlock P S.toStrategy.ιB))) = 1
   119	        rw [heteroKron_one_one]
   120	        ext row col

## Result

The named target `exists_extractionWitness_ofGlobalPairWitness` remains open.
Its signature, error scale, quantifiers, and existing `sorry` are unchanged.
No axiom, proof hole, or load-bearing assumption is added. This packet proves

The source is `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex`,

## Mathematics

For the characteristic-two Pauli label space V, define
H_W = |V|^{-1} sum_u tau_W(u) tensor tau_W(u). Fourier inversion identifies
H_Z with the diagonal projection onto equal labels. The simultaneous shift
average H_X then gives H_X H_Z = |EPR><EPR| with coefficient |V|^{-1},
not the normalized-trace density coefficient. These identities hold also when
the coordinate index is empty, since V is still nonempty.

For any finite auxiliary register R, I_R tensor H_W is a contraction, being an
average of unitaries. If a unit vector theta has both correlations at least
1 - delta/2, expansion of its squared distance from each correlation average
bounds that distance by sqrt(delta). Splitting
theta - H_X H_Z theta into the two successive errors gives a projection
distance at most 2 sqrt(delta). This proves the corrected estimate without
the numerical errors at paper lines 1753-1763.

The partial inner product with EPR defines aux_0. The new coordinate identity
proves that aux_0 tensor EPR is exactly the projected state, including the
actual heterogeneous six-register placement. Reusing the existing auxiliary
normalization theorem gives a unit aux at distance at most twice the projection
error. When the projection vanishes, a normalized reference vector obtained
from the original strategy and one EPR pair handles that case. The resulting
state estimate, once the correlation premise has been derived, is at most
4 sqrt(delta), or 16 delta in squared norm.

   "body": "<!-- mipstarre-issue-key: stage43-unfiled-combining-lines -->\n### Target declarations\n\nIn `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Lines.lean` prove:\n\n- line 47 \u2014 `exists_combinedLinesWitness_ofPointsWitness`\n- line 67 \u2014 `exists_combinedLinesWitness`\n- line 88 \u2014 `linePointDist_eq_mixture_restricted`\n- line 107 \u2014 `avg_restricted_le`\n- line 130 \u2014 `avg_restricted_prod_le`\n- line 164 \u2014 `restricted_lines_consistency_bound`\n- line 183 \u2014 `exists_subLineWitness`\n\n### Paper and blueprint references\n\n- Combined line construction:\n  `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:882-969`.\n- Restricted laws and subline construction:\n  `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1038-1139`.\n- `blueprint/src/chapter/ch15_qpbt_combining.tex:349-892`,\n  `lem:qld-xz-lines`, `lem:restricted-line-mixture-bounds`, and\n  `lem:qld-sublines`.\n\n### Dependencies\n\n- #117 must merge for joint points, polynomial combination, and restricted seeds.\n- #99 and #116 must merge for pasting and expanded line consistency.\n- #109 supplies the direct-index low-degree soundness route.\n- This packet has exclusive ownership of `Combining/Lines.lean`.\n\n### Acceptance\n\n- All seven target declarations are proved with unchanged signatures and error functions.\n- `lake env lean MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Lines.lean` and direct consumers are green.\n- Fully discharged source nodes receive proof-level `\\leanok`.\n- No new `sorry`, `admit`, axiom, prohibited bypass, point-witness bridge,\n  dimension-divisibility hypothesis, or altered error exponent is introduced.\n- Full build, statement audit, declaration checking, blueprint rendering,\n  exact-head CI, and independent review pass.\n\n### Scope notes\n\nPreserve both source-facing and `_ofPointsWitness` forms, equal-mixture\nidentities, exact inflation factors, all placement comparisons, and the\ndirect-index extended-line carrier. Own only the listed file and matching\nblueprint proof status. Main locators are from `c1c0af4`.\n\n---\nStage 4.3 proof packet under #47.\n\nPrerequisites are recorded as GitHub issue dependencies (blocked_by); the bullets above are commentary.\n",

   "body": "### Motivation\n\nThe full speed run of 2026-09-12 (04:17Z\u201308:33Z) produced 9 merges and cost the owner\neight distinct classes of manual intervention, each of which is a defect of the workflow\nrather than of the mathematics: the concurrency limits restated five times while ~90\nworker sessions died (69 on an endpoint that had been answering 503 for an hour, the rest\nabove an unmeasured provider ceiling); repeated questions about idle slots while every\ndispatched fixer was dying at a model-policy preflight; the estimate format dictated by\nhand after multi-line prose appeared on the estimate issue; ready PRs sitting open behind\ntwo-hour timer backoffs; three lane-runner revisions hand-patched in `/tmp`; the speed\ntier switched three times by string surgery on a generated file; and a terminal stop order\nundone five minutes later by a goal keeper that had no way to know about it.\n\nThis PR is the whole of the tracker's seven work items: the owner gives **one** briefing at\nthe start of a run and afterwards receives only the half-hourly one-line estimate and prose\nprogress on the progress log. Everything else becomes an automatic mechanism, a one-file\nswitch or a self-healing loop, and every fix that lived in `/tmp` or in one host's\n`.git/config` now lives in the repository. The design document is the first comment on\n#550.\n\n### Description\n\n**1. Owner briefing, run mode and standing reports.** `local/bin/run_mode.py` validates one\n`run-brief.json` and is the single writer of `watchdog/run-mode.json` and of the derived cap\nfiles, and the single accessor for every capacity, schedule, speed and issue number, so no\nprotocol, persona or script carries a literal that can go stale. `ready_report.py` answers\n\"ready but open, and why\" hourly from daemon state, with `unexplained` as the alarm case.\n`estimate_post.py` renders the two prescribed lines and refuses any other body.\n`local/protocols/full-speed-mode.md` is the runbook and `local/personas/main.md` gains the\nStanding reports duty.\n\n**2. Dispatch and telemetry.** Provider failures are classified (`concurrency_limit`,\n`endpoint_5xx`, `retries_exhausted`, `timeout`, `task_failure`, `unknown`) and recorded with\nthe endpoint, so a capacity refusal is no longer scored like a failed proof; `dispatch.sh`\nspools its request and prompt and retries a transient class instead of dying; a branch claim\nrefuses a second writer with exit 5; the owner model override moves from a PATH-shim rewrite\n(which made the registry record a model that never ran) into the policy layer; `autofix.sh`\nstops defaulting to a model its own preflight rejects and gains the fix \u2192 CI \u2192 review loop.\n\n**3. Capacity controller.** An AIMD controller with per-endpoint health is the only writer of\nthe caps: it measures the real limit under the briefed ceiling, trips to cap 0 on a 5xx\nendpoint, recovers through one half-open read-only probe, subtracts declared external\nconsumers, and carries the measurement into the next run.\n\n**4. Operator tools.** One versioned installer with a hash manifest that refuses to overwrite\na hand patch; one `owner-pause.sh` whose every phase is clamped to the briefed deadline and\nwhich releases queued dispatches rather than killing them; one `owner-resume.sh` that\nrestores from the recorded state only; one `owner-say.sh` whose terminal mode holds the goal\nbefore it speaks.\n\n**5. Merge daemon and lane runner, promoted.** Honest names in the repository, failure markers\nthat carry a class and clear on an observable change instead of a timer, PAR sized from the\nmachine, the lane's build under the machine-wide lease, a retirement pass \u2014 and the lane's\n`MIPSTARRE_SKIP_HOOKS=1` fallback push deleted.\n\n**6. Self-repair janitor.** One idempotent sweep of five passes, each selecting by record\nfield: no date glob and no filename digit filter anywhere.\n\n**7. Merge hygiene and build reachability.** A committed `.gitattributes` union driver for the\nappend-only logs, asserted by `worktree-setup.sh`; and a reachability guard inside the\nexisting `local-ci/build` step that names a module left outside the umbrella import closure.\n\n**No proof-integrity mechanism is touched.** No change to `.githooks/*`,\n`merge_loss_guard.py`, `checked-push.sh`, the seven `pr_merge.py` gates, the eight canonical\n`local-ci/<step>` contexts or the review-verdict contract. The one place a current tool\n*bypassed* a gate \u2014 the lane's hook-skipping fallback push \u2014 is removed, which strengthens it.\n\n### Testing\n\nRun in the branch worktree on the build host.\n\n- `python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts/tests -p 'test_*.py'` \u2192 **977 tests, OK**\n  (9 skipped: the historical useful-queue scenarios retired by #505). That is the command the\n  pre-commit hook runs, and it ran on every commit here that stages a `scripts/` file.\n- `bash -n` on all 24 changed shell files and both renderings of the generated PATH shim: clean.\n- `python3 -m py_compile` on all 26 changed Python files: clean. `json.load` on\n  `model-policy.json`, `capacity-pol\n\n---\nCloses #550\n",

-  "body": "### Motivation\n- Advance the EPR projection and normalization argument needed by #523, paper `lem:qld-unitary`, lines 1725-1783, and blueprint `lem:qld-unitary`.\n\n### Description\n- Prove the paired Pauli-average identity `H_X H_Z = |EPR><EPR|`, contraction with arbitrary auxiliary registers, and the corrected projection-distance bound `2 sqrt(delta)`.\n- Construct the partial-inner-product auxiliary vector in the actual six-register coordinates and normalize it using the existing theorem, including the zero-projection case. Reuse five coordinate/reference declarations from saved commit `9b75a5f8`; expose the existing Pauli coordinate formulas without changing their proofs.\n- Preserve the complete signature and existing proof obligation of `exists_extractionWitness_ofGlobalPairWitness`. Correlation transport, total-Pauli measurement comparison, and common error constants remain to be proved. No new proof holes, axioms, or target assumptions are introduced. The separate blueprint node marks only the proved auxiliary results.\n- Record source integrity, provenance, historical costs, and remaining prerequisites in `audits/2026-09-12_issue-523_epr-projection.md`.\n\n### Testing\n- Focused Lean checks pass for both new modules, `Algebra/PauliTheorems.lean`, and `Extraction/Unitary.lean`.\n- Axiom audit: all ten inspected new/newly public proofs use only `propext`, `Classical.choice`, and `Quot.sound`; the unchanged target still uses `sorryAx`.\n- Source-header, whitespace, line-length, proof-integrity scan, hook installation, and blueprint LaTeX checks pass. Blueprint web rendering passes with existing bibliography warnings. All 1,683 blueprint declarations resolve; synchronization retains 235 pre-existing stale index entries.\n- The full locked Lean build and proof-integrity CI gates passed at `4109e55a`. CI found an undefined blueprint macro, corrected in `c86af17c`; `leanblueprint pdf` now passes. The workflow-fixture suite also failed `test_dispatch_command_selects_routine_sol_and_reasoned_hard_astra` with dispatcher exit 4 despite scrubbed model/effort variables. Final-head CI must be rerun; this partial result does not close #523.\n\n---\nAddresses #523\n",
+  "body": "### Motivation\n\nComplete issue #523's conditional extraction constructor near paper\nlem:qld-unitary, QPBT section 14, lines 1666-1860. The separate global-witness\nand isometry-transfer obligations remain recorded in\ndocs/paper-gaps/qpbt_extraction-transfer.tex.\n\n### Description\n\nGiven a GlobalPairWitness, the concrete swap maps now construct a normalized\nauxiliary state, the state-extraction bound, and both players' full total-Pauli\ncomparison bounds. The public statement, universal quantifier order, complete\nanswer sums, and nested extraction error scale are unchanged.\n\nThe proof covers small and large errors with one universal constant. Preserved\nswap, consistency, EPR and overlap proofs retain their recorded provenance.\nThe five original consistency holes are unused. The source blueprint node\nremains notready; the conditional node retains the required marker and the\nproof-tag restriction imposed by the normal hooks.\n\n### Testing\n\nMain integration passed 95 focused Lean modules/co-imports, normal hooks,\nblueprint rendering/synchronization and all 1,454 declaration checks. The full\nconstructor and ten supporting queries use only propext, Classical.choice and\nQuot.sound. Thirteen existing blueprint warnings remain. Canonical CI passed on the published head; independent review remains pending.\n\n---\nCloses #523\n",

+# Issue #523: EPR projection prerequisite
+
+Session: `prover-523-20260912-01`, starting at 2026-09-12 05:04:36 UTC.
+Base: `ae124f8f09ee002444ac5b9711822c0f1daae142`.
+
+## Result
+
+The named target `exists_extractionWitness_ofGlobalPairWitness` remains open.
+Its signature, error scale, quantifiers, and existing `sorry` are unchanged.
+No axiom, proof hole, or load-bearing assumption is added. This packet proves
+the independent EPR projection and auxiliary normalization prerequisites.
+
+The source is `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex`,
+`lem:qld-unitary`, lines 1666-1860. The new calculations correspond to
+lines 1725-1783. The blueprint records them separately at
+`thm:qld-epr-projection-estimates`; neither `lem:qld-unitary` nor its conditional
+given-witness auxiliary is marked proved.
+
+## Mathematics
+
+For the characteristic-two Pauli label space V, define
+H_W = |V|^{-1} sum_u tau_W(u) tensor tau_W(u). Fourier inversion identifies
+H_Z with the diagonal projection onto equal labels. The simultaneous shift
+average H_X then gives H_X H_Z = |EPR><EPR| with coefficient |V|^{-1},
+not the normalized-trace density coefficient. These identities hold also when
+the coordinate index is empty, since V is still nonempty.
+
+For any finite auxiliary register R, I_R tensor H_W is a contraction, being an
+average of unitaries. If a unit vector theta has both correlations at least
+1 - delta/2, expansion of its squared distance from each correlation average
+bounds that distance by sqrt(delta). Splitting
+theta - H_X H_Z theta into the two successive errors gives a projection
+distance at most 2 sqrt(delta). This proves the corrected estimate without
+the numerical errors at paper lines 1753-1763.
+
+The partial inner product with EPR defines aux_0. The new coordinate identity
+proves that aux_0 tensor EPR is exactly the projected state, including the
+actual heterogeneous six-register placement. Reusing the existing auxiliary
+normalization theorem gives a unit aux at distance at most twice the projection
+error. When the projection vanishes, a normalized reference vector obtained
+from the original strategy and one EPR pair handles that case. The resulting
+state estimate, once the correlation premise has been derived, is at most
+4 sqrt(delta), or 16 delta in squared norm.
+

+## Source of Truth

+## Findings
+
+Every selected sum of effects of a complete measurement is a positive
+contraction. Applied to the product measurement, this bounds the entire overlap
+operator, without an outcome-cardinality factor. Its expectation changes by at
+most twice the norm distance between unit vectors.
+`pauli_overlap_transfer` combines this fact with Schwartz--Zippel: the evaluated
+overlap on a unit theta is at most the full diagonal overlap on a unit Delta
+plus `md/q + 2 * norm(theta - Delta)`.
+
+For a local POVM A with Pauli-register outcomes and normalized
+Delta = aux tensor EPR, let E(theta) denote A's evaluated overlap with the
+canonical Pauli measurement on the opposite register. The theorem
+`pauli_distance_on_ideal_le` bounds the full answer-summed distance between A
+and the canonical projectors on its own register by
+`2 * (1 - E(theta)) + 2md/q + 4 * norm(theta - Delta)`.
+The exact EPR transport is `extracted_epr_actions_eq`. The two auxiliary spaces
+are arbitrary and heterogeneous, so the estimate applies to either player by
+interchanging them. It is not yet instantiated with the concrete swap expressions.
+
+`evaluated_pauli_tilde_consistency_ofGlobalPairWitness` proves both evaluated
+total-Pauli/pulled-apart consistency estimates on `S.psiHat`, at one universal
+construction scale. It combines the recovered full point estimates with point
+self-consistency and both orientations of the actual game's Pauli-basis check.
+It does not invoke any of the five original `Consistency.lean` holes.
+
+`extraction_small_error_absorption` proves that if `0 <= delta <= 1` and
+`C >= 18`, both `16 * delta` and `2 * delta + 2md/q + 16 * sqrt(delta)`
+are at most `deltaExtract C delta m d q`. This is the scalar estimate needed
+after the concrete operator comparison and the previously proved state bound.

+conjugated by that block's swap; let T be the canonical measurement on the
+opposite extracted register. Prove that the evaluated Q/T overlap on the
+reindexed swapped state is one minus the corresponding evaluated-Pauli/tildeM
+consistency defect on `S.psiHat`. Use `swapUnitary_conj_tildeM`, the exact

   213	
   214	The next lemma shows that the pulled-apart measurements are consistent with the original points measurements of the strategy, and self-consistent. Write $\delta_G$ for the error of the global polynomial-pair witness supplied by Lemma~\ref{lem:qld-4-7}. Assume $0\leq\eps\leq1$ and $\delta_G\geq0$, and put
   215	\[
   216		B = \delta_G + \sqrt{\eps} + \frac{md}{q}.
   217	\]
   218	Each displayed construction estimate below has its own universal constant $C_E \geq 1$, quantified independently, and its own scale $\delta_P^E=C_EB$. The source uses one enlarged error $\delta_S$ for all of these estimates. The two presentations agree: after the finitely many estimates have been established, take $C_* = \max_E C_E$ and $\delta_P=C_*B$. Since $B\geq0$, every bound remains valid at this common scale. In the proof paragraphs, $\delta_P$ denotes this common enlargement. It has the same asymptotic form as $\delta_G$: after shrinking $b$ to at most $1/2$, the term $\eps^b$ dominates $\sqrt{\eps}$ for $0 \leq \eps \leq 1$, while $(md)^a q^{-b}$ dominates $md/q$.

+import MIPStarRE.QPBT.Extraction.EncodingSupport
+import MIPStarRE.QPBT.Extraction.PolynomialCollision

+/-!
+# Consistency with encoding-supported reference measurements
+
+The Pauli-basis check remains a consistency estimate after adjoining the
+perfectly correlated ideal point measurement. Schwartz-Zippel then controls
+mass outside the encoding image by evaluated reference inconsistency.
+
+## References
+
+- Blueprint `eq:qld-nonencoding-mass` and `lem:qld-nonencoding-mass-bound`.
+- `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:197-264,383-418`.
+- `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_decoding-identity.tex`.
+- The reference and comparison constructions reused here are from commits
+  `55ae7487`, `36c07381`, `ff4c92d1`, `84c7ec43`, and `7f916eb8`.
+- These are auxiliary estimates for a supplied witness, not its construction.
+-/
+
+open scoped BigOperators Matrix MatrixOrder ComplexOrder
+open scoped Classical
+
+namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
+
+open MIPStarRE.LDT hiding Measurement
+open MIPStarRE.Quantum DistanceCalculus ProjectiveSetting
+
+noncomputable section
+
+/-- For commuting families, reversing the order of the measurements preserves
+the consistency defect. This is finite-sum algebra for opposite placements. -/
+theorem consistencyDefect_comm_of_commute {X A I : Type*}
+    [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A]
+    [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] (mu : Distribution X)
+    (first second : X → A → Op I) (psi : EuclideanSpace ℂ I)
+    (hcomm : ∀ x a b, first x a * second x b = second x b * first x a) :
+    consistencyDefect mu first second psi = consistencyDefect mu second first psi := by
+  unfold consistencyDefect
+  apply avgOver_congr
+  intro x
+  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
+  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+  intro b _
+  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+  intro a _
+  simp only [hcomm x a b, eq_comm]
+
+/-- A polynomial measurement's mass outside the encoding image is at most
+its evaluated inconsistency with an encoding-supported reference, plus `md/q`.
+This is the Schwartz-Zippel step in blueprint `eq:qld-nonencoding-mass`.
+The reference support is explicit because this auxiliary applies to any POVM;
+the concrete reference above proves it without an additional strategy premise. -/
+theorem mass_outside_encoding_le_evaluated_defect {P : AdmissibleParams}
+    {I J : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] [Fintype J] [DecidableEq J]
+    (meas : Measurement (Poly P) I) (reference : Measurement (Poly P) J)
+    (psi : EuclideanSpace ℂ (I × J)) (hpsi : ‖psi‖ = 1)
+    (hsupport : ∀ g, ¬ IsEncoding g → reference.effect g = 0) :
+    (∑ g ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun g : Poly P => ¬ IsEncoding g),
+      stateQForm psi (heteroKron (meas.effect g) 1)) ≤
+      consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P))
+        (fun u a => heteroKron ((meas.postprocess (fun g => evalPoly g u)).effect a) 1)
+        (fun u a => heteroKron 1 ((reference.postprocess
+          (fun g => evalPoly g u)).effect a)) psi + (P.m * P.d : ℝ) / P.q := by
+  classical
+  have hmass := mass_outside_support_le_point_defect meas reference psi
+    (Finset.univ.filter IsEncoding) (by simpa using hsupport)
+  simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hmass
+  have hcollision := SandwichProduct.point_codeword_defect_le_avg_evaluated_add
+    meas reference psi evalPoly ((P.m * P.d : ℝ) / P.q) hpsi
+    (by positivity) poly_eval_collision_le
+  refine hmass.trans (hcollision.trans_eq ?_)
+  rw [SandwichProduct.consistencyDefect_placed_eq_avg_point]
+
+namespace ProjectiveSetting
+
+/-- The ideal point measurement has zero off-diagonal mass on its EPR pair.
+This follows from the existing unit diagonal-overlap calculation. -/
+private theorem tauPoint_offDiagonal_eq_zero {P : AdmissibleParams}
+    (W : PauliKind) (u : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) :
+    (∑ a : PauliScalar P, ∑ b : PauliScalar P, if a = b then 0 else
+      stateQForm (eprState (PauliRegister P))
+        (heteroKron (tauPointProj W u a) (tauPointProj W u b))) = 0 := by
+  have h := point_defect_eq (leftPlacedMeasurement (tauPointMeas W u))
+    (rightPlacedMeasurement (tauPointMeas W u)) (eprState (PauliRegister P))
+  simpa only [leftPlacedMeasurement, rightPlacedMeasurement, Measurement.ofSumEqOne,
+    placed_product_stateQForm_eq, tauPointMeas, eprState_norm, one_pow,
+    sum_tauPointProj_pair_stateQForm_eprState, sub_self] using h
+
+/-- Adjoining the ideal point outcomes preserves the Pauli-basis check on the
+two-player expanded state, in the point--Pauli orientation. -/
+theorem point_encodingPauli_consistency_eq {P : AdmissibleParams} {epsilon : ℝ}
+    (S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon) (W : PauliKind) :
+    consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P))
+        (fun u a => heteroKron ((S.pointMeasExp .alice W u).effect a) 1)
+        (fun u a => heteroKron 1 (((S.encodingPauliMeas .bob W).postprocess
+          (fun g => evalPoly g u)).effect a)) (ExtendedLineGame.pairState S) =
+      consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P))
+        (fun u a => heteroKron ((S.pointMeas .alice W u).effect a) 1)
+        (fun u a => heteroKron 1 ((S.pauliEvalMeas .bob W u).effect a))
+        S.toStrategy.ψ := by
+  have h := consistencyDefect_convolution_eq_of_perfect
+    (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P))
+    (S.pointMeas .alice W) (S.pauliEvalMeas .bob W)
+    (tauPointMeas W) (tauPointMeas W) S.toStrategy.ψ
+    (eprState (PauliRegister P)) (eprState_norm _)
+    (tauPoint_offDiagonal_eq_zero W)
+  simpa only [pointMeasExp, Measurement.ofSumEqOne, expPointOp_eq_convolution,
+    encodingPauliMeas_eval_effect_eq_convolution, tauPointMeas,
+    ExtendedLineGame.pairState] using h
+
+/-- The same exact preservation holds in the Pauli--point orientation. -/
+theorem encodingPauli_point_consistency_eq {P : AdmissibleParams} {epsilon : ℝ}
+    (S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon) (W : PauliKind) :
+    consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P))
+        (fun u a => heteroKron (((S.encodingPauliMeas .alice W).postprocess
+          (fun g => evalPoly g u)).effect a) 1)
+        (fun u a => heteroKron 1 ((S.pointMeasExp .bob W u).effect a))
+        (ExtendedLineGame.pairState S) =
+      consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P))
+        (fun u a => heteroKron ((S.pauliEvalMeas .alice W u).effect a) 1)
+        (fun u a => heteroKron 1 ((S.pointMeas .bob W u).effect a))
+        S.toStrategy.ψ := by
+  have h := consistencyDefect_convolution_eq_of_perfect
+    (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P))
+    (S.pauliEvalMeas .alice W) (S.pointMeas .bob W)
+    (tauPointMeas W) (tauPointMeas W) S.toStrategy.ψ
+    (eprState (PauliRegister P)) (eprState_norm _)
+    (tauPoint_offDiagonal_eq_zero W)
+  simpa only [pointMeasExp, Measurement.ofSumEqOne, expPointOp_eq_convolution,
+    encodingPauliMeas_eval_effect_eq_convolution, tauPointMeas,
+    ExtendedLineGame.pairState] using h
+
+/-- Adjoining the same ideal point measurements also preserves point
+self-consistency exactly. -/
+theorem expanded_point_consistency_eq {P : AdmissibleParams} {epsilon : ℝ}
+    (S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon) (W : PauliKind) :
+    consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P))
+        (fun u a => heteroKron ((S.pointMeasExp .alice W u).effect a) 1)
+        (fun u a => heteroKron 1 ((S.pointMeasExp .bob W u).effect a))
+        (ExtendedLineGame.pairState S) =
+      consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P))
+        (fun u a => heteroKron ((S.pointMeas .alice W u).effect a) 1)
+        (fun u a => heteroKron 1 ((S.pointMeas .bob W u).effect a))
+        S.toStrategy.ψ := by
+  have h := consistencyDefect_convolution_eq_of_perfect
+    (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P))
+    (S.pointMeas .alice W) (S.pointMeas .bob W)
+    (tauPointMeas W) (tauPointMeas W) S.toStrategy.ψ
+    (eprState (PauliRegister P)) (eprState_norm _)
+    (tauPoint_offDiagonal_eq_zero W)
+  simpa only [pointMeasExp, Measurement.ofSumEqOne, expPointOp_eq_convolution,
+    tauPointMeas, ExtendedLineGame.pairState] using h
+
+end ProjectiveSetting
+
+/-- The right-hand marginal version of the support estimate, obtained by
+interchanging the two tensor factors and using the same collision bound. -/
+theorem right_mass_outside_encoding_le_evaluated_defect {P : AdmissibleParams}
+    {I J : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] [Fintype J] [DecidableEq J]
+    (reference : Measurement (Poly P) I) (meas : Measurement (Poly P) J)
+    (psi : EuclideanSpace ℂ (I × J)) (hpsi : ‖psi‖ = 1)
+    (hsupport : ∀ g, ¬ IsEncoding g → reference.effect g = 0) :
+    (∑ g ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun g : Poly P => ¬ IsEncoding g),
+      stateQForm psi (heteroKron 1 (meas.effect g))) ≤
+      consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P))
+        (fun u a => heteroKron ((reference.postprocess
+          (fun g => evalPoly g u)).effect a) 1)
+        (fun u a => heteroKron 1 ((meas.postprocess (fun g => evalPoly g u)).effect a))
+        psi + (P.m * P.d : ℝ) / P.q := by
+  have h := mass_outside_encoding_le_evaluated_defect meas reference
+    (reindexState (Equiv.prodComm I J) psi)
+    (by rw [reindexState_norm_eq, hpsi]) hsupport
+  simpa only [WinImplications.stateQForm_reindexState,
+    WinImplications.reindexOp_prodComm_heteroKron,
+    WinImplications.consistencyDefect_swappedState] using h
+
+/-- Both evaluated global marginals are consistent with the opposite
+encoding-supported reference. The universal square-root coefficient comes
+from the two Pauli-basis checks and point self-consistency; it does not assume
+the non-encoding support estimate or the existence of a global witness. -/
+theorem global_marginal_encoding_consistency :
+    ∃ C : ℝ, 1 ≤ C ∧ ∀ (P : AdmissibleParams) (epsilon deltaG : ℝ),
+      0 ≤ epsilon → ∀ (S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon)
+        (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG) (W : PauliKind),
+      consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P))
+          (fun u a => heteroKron (((w.marginalPoly .alice W).postprocess
+            (fun g => evalPoly g u)).effect a) 1)
+          (fun u a => heteroKron 1 (((S.encodingPauliMeas .bob W).postprocess

+/-- A marginal acting on `AA'` has the same mass in the extraction-block
+notation and the two-player expanded state. The unused registers carry identities. -/
+theorem stateQForm_placeSide_alice_tensor_one {P : AdmissibleParams} {epsilon : ℝ}
+    (S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon) (A : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace .alice))
+    (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
+    stateQForm S.psiHat (S.placeSide .alice (heteroKron A (1 : Op (PauliRegister P)))) =
+      stateQForm (ExtendedLineGame.pairState S) (heteroKron A 1) := by
+  have hplace : S.placeSide .alice (heteroKron A (1 : Op (PauliRegister P))) =
+      S.place .AA' A := by
+    ext row col
+    simp only [placeSide, sixRegExtractionEquiv, reindexOp, place, heteroKron,
+      Matrix.kronecker, Matrix.one_apply, mul_ite, ite_mul]
+    split_ifs <;> simp_all
+    rfl
+  rw [hplace]
+  have h := ExtendedLineGame.stateQForm_pairState_eq_AA'_BA'' S A 1 hA
+    Matrix.isHermitian_one
+  have hone : S.place .BA'' (1 : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace .bob)) = 1 := by
+    convert S.place_one .BA'' using 1
+    rfl
+  rw [hone, Matrix.mul_one] at h
+  exact h.symm
+
+/-- The corresponding marginal-mass identity for `BB'`. The opposite placement
+uses the second EPR pair, as in the witness's Bob consistency hypothesis. -/
+theorem stateQForm_placeSide_bob_tensor_one {P : AdmissibleParams} {epsilon : ℝ}
+    (S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon) (B : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace .bob))
+    (hB : B.IsHermitian) :
+    stateQForm S.psiHat (S.placeSide .bob (heteroKron B (1 : Op (PauliRegister P)))) =
+      stateQForm (ExtendedLineGame.pairState S) (heteroKron 1 B) := by
+  have hplace : S.placeSide .bob (heteroKron B (1 : Op (PauliRegister P))) =
+      S.place .BB' B := by
+    ext row col
+    simp only [placeSide, sixRegExtractionEquiv, reindexOp, place, heteroKron,
+      Matrix.kronecker, Matrix.one_apply, mul_ite, ite_mul]
+    split_ifs <;> simp_all
+    rfl
+  rw [hplace]
+  have h := ExtendedLineGame.stateQForm_pairState_eq_AB''_BB' S 1 B
+    Matrix.isHermitian_one hB
+  have hone : S.place .AB'' (1 : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace .alice)) = 1 := by
+    convert S.place_one .AB'' using 1
+    rfl
+  rw [hone, Matrix.one_mul] at h
+  exact h.symm
+
+end

+/-- For a supplied global polynomial-pair witness, the pulled-apart defect is
+bounded by its point-consistency error plus the non-encoding mass. This is the
+support-restricted form of the calculation in paper
+`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1483-1492`, supporting blueprint
+`lem:qld-construct-the-paulis`. It uses no estimate for the non-encoding mass;
+the need for that separate estimate is explained in
+`docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_decoding-identity.tex`. -/
+theorem tildeM_consistencyDefect_le_deltaG_add_nonencoding
+    {P : AdmissibleParams} {epsilon deltaG : ℝ} {S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon}
+    (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG) (W : PauliKind) :
+    consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P))
+      (fun u a => S.placePlayer .alice ((S.pointMeas .alice W u).effect a))
+      (fun u a => S.placeSide .bob (tildeM w .bob W (indicatorVec u) a)) S.psiHat ≤
+      deltaG + nonencodingMarginalMass w .bob W := by
+  classical
+  let mu := uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)
+  let evaluated := fun u : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P =>
+    S.placedMeasurement .BB' ((w.marginalPoly .bob W).postprocess
+      (fun g => MvPolynomial.eval u g.1))
+  let expanded := fun u : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P =>
+    S.placedMeasurement .AB'' (S.pointMeasExp .alice W u)
+  have hdefect := consistencyDefect_eq_one_sub_overlap mu evaluated expanded S.psiHat
+    (uniformDistribution_isProbability _) S.psiHat_norm
+  have hw := marginalPoly_pointMeas_consistent_bob w W
+  change consistencyDefect mu (fun u a => (evaluated u).effect a)
+    (fun u a => (expanded u).effect a) S.psiHat ≤ deltaG at hw
+  rw [hdefect] at hw
+  have hregroup (u : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) :
+      (∑ a : PauliScalar P, stateQForm S.psiHat
+        ((evaluated u).effect a * (expanded u).effect a)) =
+      ∑ g : Poly P, stateQForm S.psiHat
+        (S.place .BB' ((w.marginalPoly .bob W).effect g) *
+          S.place .AB'' ((S.pointMeasExp .alice W u).effect
+            (MvPolynomial.eval u g.1))) := by
+    rw [← stateQForm_finset_sum]
+    change stateQForm S.psiHat
+      (∑ a : PauliScalar P, S.place .BB'
+        (((w.marginalPoly .bob W).postprocess
+          (fun g => MvPolynomial.eval u g.1)).effect a) *
+            S.place .AB'' ((S.pointMeasExp .alice W u).effect a)) = _
+    exact (congrArg (stateQForm S.psiHat)
+      (sum_marginalPoly_eval_mul w .BB' W u
+        (fun a => S.place .AB'' ((S.pointMeasExp .alice W u).effect a)))).trans
+      (stateQForm_finset_sum _ _ _)
+  simp only [hregroup] at hw
+  have hcompare := avgOver_mono mu _ _
+    (fun u => marginal_eval_overlap_le_decoded_add_nonencoding w W u)
+  rw [avgOver_add, avgOver_const_of_isProbability mu
+    (uniformDistribution_isProbability _)] at hcompare
+  have hmass_eq : nonencodingMarginalMass w .bob W =
+      ∑ g ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun g : Poly P => ¬ IsEncoding g),
+        stateQForm S.psiHat (S.place .BB' ((w.marginalPoly .bob W).effect g)) := by
+    unfold nonencodingMarginalMass
+    simp only [S.placeSide_bob_tensor_one]
+    rfl
+  rw [← hmass_eq] at hcompare
+  rw [tildeM_consistencyDefect_eq_one_sub_decoded_overlap]
+  dsimp only [mu] at hw hcompare
+  linarith

+/-- Conditional consistency of Alice's original point measurement with Bob's
+pulled-apart measurement, averaged over uniformly random points. This is the
+supplied-witness form of the first display of Item 1 in paper
+`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1463-1492`.

+The source reuses `deltaS` after absorbing the non-encoding and game-error
+terms. The bound keeps the global polynomial-pair witness error `deltaG`
+separate in `deltaConstructPaulis`.

+The encoding-supported reference and Schwartz--Zippel estimates in
+`NonencodingSupport` control the non-encoding mass required by the restricted
+decoder identity; see `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_decoding-identity.tex`.

+Issue #518 and `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_decoding-identity.tex` record this distinction.
+Elimination: discharge the construction required by `exists_pulled_apart_consistency`

+obligation `nonencodingMarginalMass_le`. -/

+    ∃ C : ℝ, 1 ≤ C ∧
+      ∀ (P : AdmissibleParams) (epsilon deltaG : ℝ),

+              (fun u a =>
+                S.placePlayer .alice ((S.pointMeas .alice W u).effect a))
+              (fun u a => S.placeSide .bob
+                (tildeM w .bob W (indicatorVec u) a))

+        (heteroKron ((w.marginalPoly .bob W).effect g) (1 : Op (PauliRegister P))))) ≤ _

+    exact hmass.trans (add_le_add href le_rfl)

+  have hratio : 0 ≤ (P.m * P.d : ℝ) / P.q := by positivity
+  have hsqrt : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt epsilon := Real.sqrt_nonneg epsilon

    19	\section{At a glance}
    20	
    21	\begin{itemize}
    22	  \item \textbf{Difficulty.} Medium.  The extraction proof contains two
    23	  incorrect numerical steps and later suppresses the range projection when
    24	  passing from unitary conjugation to isometry conjugation.
    25	  \item \textbf{Estimated weight.} A corrected positive-contraction estimate,
    26	  a small-error case split for normalization, and one range-projection transfer
    27	  lemma for a projective measurement family.
    28	  \item \textbf{Mathlib/project split.} Positivity, contraction inequalities,
    29	  isometry range projections, and norm estimates belong to finite-dimensional
    30	  Hilbert-space algebra.  The state-dependent family distance and register
    31	  placements are project-local.
    32	  \item \textbf{Key mathematical inputs.} The inequality
    33	  $H^2\geq2H-I$ for a positive contraction, the triangle inequality, and
    34	  $Q=\phi\phi^\dagger$ for an isometry.  The repair is tracked in
    35	  \ghissue{19}.
    36	\end{itemize}
    37	
    38	\section{Key theorem forms}
    39	
    40	Let $H_X$ and $H_Z$ be the positive contractions of the extraction proof, and
    41	let $\vartheta$ be a unit vector such that
    42	\[
    43	  \langle\vartheta,H_W\vartheta\rangle\geq1-\delta/2
    44	  \qquad (W\in\{X,Z\}).
    45	\]
    46	Since $(I-H_W)^2\geq0$,
    47	\[
    48	  H_W^2\geq2H_W-I,
    49	  \qquad
    50	  \langle\vartheta,H_W^2\vartheta\rangle\geq1-\delta.
    51	\]
    52	Also $\lVert(I-H_W)\vartheta\rVert^2\leq\delta$, whence
    53	\[
    54	  \lVert H_X\vartheta-H_Z\vartheta\rVert^2\leq4\delta.
    55	\]
    56	Together with $H_XH_Z$ equal to the EPR projection, these estimates give the
    57	required overlap bound, with constants absorbed into the stated
    58	$O(\sqrt\delta)$ error.
    59	
    60	For the final transfer, let $\phi\colon\mathcal H\to\mathcal K$ be an isometry
    61	and set $Q=\phi\phi^\dagger$.  If $N_h$ is the unitary-conjugated extension of
    62	a measurement operator $M_h$, then the exact identity is
    63	\[
    64	  \phi M_h\phi^\dagger=N_hQ=QN_h,
    65	\]
    66	not merely $N_h$.  Thus comparison of $N_h$ with an ideal projector must be
    67	combined with control of $(I-Q)\Delta$ on the ideal comparison state
    68	$\Delta$.
    69	
    70	\section{Numerical defects in the source proof}
    71	
    72	Lines~1715--1742 of
    73	\path{references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex}
    74	construct $H_X,H_Z$ and identify $H_XH_Z$ with the EPR projection.  The norm
    75	estimate at lines~1743--1750 gives
    76	$\lVert(I-H_W)\vartheta\rVert\leq\sqrt\delta$.  At lines~1753--1757 the
    77	source substitutes $\delta$ inside the reverse triangle inequality
    78	\cite[lines~1715--1783]{Ji2020MIPStar}.  That replacement is not valid for
    79	small $\delta$.  The desired lower bound on
    80	$\langle H_W^2\rangle$ follows directly from $H_W^2\geq2H_W-I$, as above.
    81	
    82	The triangle inequality yields
    83	\[
    84	  \lVert H_X\vartheta-H_Z\vartheta\rVert\leq2\sqrt\delta,
    85	\]
    86	so its square is at most $4\delta$.  Line~1761 instead bounds that square by
    87	$2\sqrt\delta$ without a stated restriction.  This inequality follows when
    88	$\delta\leq1/4$; for larger error the theorem is made trivial by enlarging the
    89	universal constant.  The same small-error split ensures that the projected
    90	vector defined at lines~1769--1773 is nonzero before it is normalized.  These
    91	are local numerical repairs and do not weaken the extraction conclusion.
    92	
    93	\section{The range-projection obligation}
    94	
    95	Lines~1827--1858 prove state-dependent closeness for the concrete operators
    96	obtained by conjugating the original measurement with the swap unitaries.
    97	Lines~1864--1875 then define isometries by adjoining EPR pairs and applying
    98	those unitaries, and immediately state the corresponding closeness for
    99	$\phi M_h\phi^\dagger$.  The omitted range projection makes this implication
   100	non-definitional \cite[lines~1827--1875]{Ji2020MIPStar}.
   101	
   102	Let $\Psi$ be the original state and suppose $\phi\Psi$ is close to the ideal
   103	state $\Delta$.  Since $Q\phi\Psi=\phi\Psi$ and $Q$ is a contraction, the
   104	triangle inequality bounds $(I-Q)\Delta$ by the state-extraction error.  Using
   105	$\phi M_h\phi^\dagger=N_hQ$, split
   106	\[
   107	  (N_hQ-T_h)\Delta
   108	  =(N_h-T_h)\Delta-N_h(I-Q)\Delta,
   109	\]
   110	where $T_h$ is the ideal Pauli projector.  Summing squared norms over $h$
   111	uses projectivity and orthogonality to keep the second term under control.
   112	The same argument is required for each player and each Pauli basis.
   113	
   114	This transfer is an open proof obligation for the next extraction stage.  It
   115	must be a theorem derived from the concrete swap unitaries, transformed-state
   116	estimate, and operator comparisons.  It must not be stored as a bridge field,
   117	residual assumption, or hypothesis of the source-labelled soundness theorem.
   118	
   119	\section{Blueprint and formalization status}
   120	
   121	The proof of Lemma~\path{lem:qld-unitary} and the soundness proof in
   122	\path{blueprint/src/chapter/ch16_qpbt_extraction.tex} use the corrected
   123	positive-contraction estimate, make the small-error case distinction explicit,
   124	and isolate the range-projection calculation.  The chapter therefore preserves
   125	the source's state and observable conclusions while exposing the omitted
   126	argument.
   127	
   128	The structure \path{ExtractionWitness} in
   129	\path{MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Unitary.lean} contains only the two-sided
   130	unitarity equations for the concrete swap maps, a normalized auxiliary state,
   131	the transformed-state estimate, and the two-player Pauli-projector comparison.
   132	The theorem \path{exists_extractionWitness_ofGlobalPairWitness} concludes the
   133	existence of this data at the explicit extraction scale, but it takes the
   134	\path{GlobalPairWitness} of Lemma~\path{lem:qld-4-7} as an explicit hypothesis
   135	rather than obtaining it from \path{exists_globalPairWitness}.  That bundle
   136	carries the projective global polynomial-pair measurements and both
   137	point-consistency estimates, and the blueprint proof of
   138	Lemma~\path{lem:qld-unitary} obtains it from Lemma~\path{lem:qld-4-7}; deleting
   139	the hypothesis would leave that construction unproved.  By the criterion of
   140	\path{docs/paper-gaps/proof-gap-protocol.tex} the hypothesis is therefore proof
   141	debt rather than a faithful boundary condition, and the declaration is a
   142	conditional helper: it does not certify the source lemma, and the blueprint
   143	node Lemma~\path{lem:qld-unitary} accordingly neither links it nor carries any
   144	statement-level formalization mark.  The declaration is recorded instead on the
   145	separate formalization-support node
   146	\path{lem:qld-unitary-given-global-pair}, whose statement assumes the global
   147	polynomial-pair measurement explicitly and whose formal link points only to the
   148	conditional helper.  It therefore cannot be mistaken for the source result.
   149	Apart from that hypothesis the
   150	conclusion matches the Stage~4.2 extraction lemma, including the corrected
   151	numerical estimates; the later passage to the isometries in the soundness
   152	theorem is not formalized, and no declaration yet states that passage.
   153	
   154	The conditional character of the result is visible wherever the declaration is
   155	invoked: the suffix \path{ofGlobalPairWitness} names the extra premise in the

   166	
   167	\section{Conclusion}
   168	
   169	The printed triangle calculation has repairable numerical errors, and the
   170	last passage from unitaries to isometries omits a genuine range-projection
   171	argument.  Neither defect is a counterexample to Pauli soundness.  The former
   172	is corrected by positive-contraction inequalities and a small-error split;
   173	the latter remains a named downstream proof obligation whose hypotheses are
   174	already supplied by the extraction lemma.  Independently of both defects, the
   175	present extraction declaration is conditional on the global polynomial-pair
   176	measurement, and that conditionality must be removed before it may be
   177	advertised as the source lemma.

   218	  have hscalar : deltaConstructPaulis L epsilon deltaG P.m P.d P.q +
   219	      2 * Real.sqrt (E * epsilon + K * epsilon) ≤
   220	        deltaConstructPaulis C epsilon deltaG P.m P.d P.q := by
   221	    have hEK : 0 ≤ E + K := add_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _)

   223	    rw [← add_mul, Real.sqrt_mul hEK]
   224	    change L * (deltaG + Real.sqrt epsilon + ((P.m * P.d : ℕ) : ℝ) / P.q) +
   225	      2 * (Real.sqrt (E + K) * Real.sqrt epsilon) ≤
   226	      (L + 2 * Real.sqrt (E + K)) *
   227	        (deltaG + Real.sqrt epsilon + ((P.m * P.d : ℕ) : ℝ) / P.q)
   228	    have hr : 0 ≤ ((P.m * P.d : ℕ) : ℝ) / P.q := by positivity
   229	    nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg (E + K)]
   230	  constructor
   231	  · change consistencyDefect mu (fun u a => (QA u).effect a)
   232	      (fun u a => (T .bob u).effect a) S.psiHat ≤ _

   237	    · rw [consistencyDefect_measurement_symm]; exact hpoints
   238	    · rw [consistencyDefect_measurement_symm]; exact hreverse
   239	  · exact (consistencyDefect_trans_le mu (T .alice) PB PA QB S.psiHat _ _ _

     5	/-!
     6	# Transfer of the complete Pauli overlap between states
     7	
     8	A selected sum of effects of a complete measurement is a positive contraction.
     9	Applied to the product measurement, this bounds the complete overlap operator,
    10	independently of the number of answers. Its expectation changes by at most twice
    11	the distance between unit vectors. Schwartz--Zippel then removes unequal Pauli
    12	encodings after the change of state.
    13	
    14	## References
    15	
    16	Blueprint `lem:qld-unitary`; paper
    17	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1827-1858`.
    18	-/

    29	/-- Any selected sum of effects of a complete measurement is a contraction.
    30	The estimate applies to the whole sum and has no outcome-cardinality factor. -/
    31	theorem norm_apply_measurement_sum_le {α ι : Type*} [Fintype α]
    32	    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (M : Measurement α ι) (s : Finset α)
    33	    (psi : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
    34	    ‖applyOperatorToState (∑ a ∈ s, M.effect a) psi‖ ≤ ‖psi‖ := by
    35	  have hpos : 0 ≤ ∑ a ∈ s, M.effect a := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun a _ => M.pos a)
    36	  have hle : ∑ a ∈ s, M.effect a ≤ 1 := by
    37	    rw [← M.sum_eq_one]
    38	    exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.subset_univ s)
    39	      (fun a _ _ => M.pos a)
    40	  apply MagicSquareRigidity.norm_applyOperatorToState_le
    41	  rw [(Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp hpos).isHermitian.eq]
    42	  exact (MIPStarRE.Quantum.sq_le_self hpos hle).trans hle
    43	
    44	/-- Changing a unit vector changes the expectation of a contraction by at most
    45	twice the vector distance. No positivity or self-adjointness is required. -/
    46	theorem abs_stateQForm_sub_le_of_contraction {ι : Type*}
    47	    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (T : Op ι)
    48	    (hT : ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι, ‖applyOperatorToState T v‖ ≤ ‖v‖)
    49	    (psi phi : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) (hpsi : ‖psi‖ = 1) (hphi : ‖phi‖ = 1) :
    50	    |stateQForm psi T - stateQForm phi T| ≤ 2 * ‖psi - phi‖ := by
    51	  have hsplit : stateQForm psi T - stateQForm phi T =
    52	      (inner ℂ (psi - phi) (applyOperatorToState T psi)).re +
    53	        (inner ℂ phi (applyOperatorToState T (psi - phi))).re := by
    54	    simp [stateQForm, applyOperatorToState]
    55	  rw [hsplit]
    56	  calc
    57	    _ ≤ |(inner ℂ (psi - phi) (applyOperatorToState T psi)).re| +
    58	        |(inner ℂ phi (applyOperatorToState T (psi - phi))).re| := abs_add_le _ _
    59	    _ ≤ ‖psi - phi‖ * ‖applyOperatorToState T psi‖ +
    60	        ‖phi‖ * ‖applyOperatorToState T (psi - phi)‖ :=
    61	      add_le_add ((Complex.abs_re_le_norm _).trans (norm_inner_le_norm _ _))
    62	        ((Complex.abs_re_le_norm _).trans (norm_inner_le_norm _ _))
    63	    _ ≤ ‖psi - phi‖ * ‖psi‖ + ‖phi‖ * ‖psi - phi‖ :=
    64	      add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hT psi) (norm_nonneg _))
    65	        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hT (psi - phi)) (norm_nonneg _))
    66	    _ = _ := by rw [hpsi, hphi]; ring
    67	
    68	/-- The complete diagonal overlap of two local measurements is stable under a
    69	change of unit state. The tensor factors can have different dimensions. -/
    70	theorem abs_diagonal_overlap_state_sub_le {α I J : Type*}
    71	    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    72	    [Fintype J] [DecidableEq J] (A : Measurement α I) (B : Measurement α J)
    73	    (psi phi : EuclideanSpace ℂ (I × J)) (hpsi : ‖psi‖ = 1) (hphi : ‖phi‖ = 1) :
    74	    |(∑ a, stateQForm psi (heteroKron (A.effect a) (B.effect a))) -
    75	      ∑ a, stateQForm phi (heteroKron (A.effect a) (B.effect a))| ≤
    76	        2 * ‖psi - phi‖ := by
    77	  let s := Finset.univ.filter (fun ab : α × α => ab.1 = ab.2)
    78	  have heq : (∑ ab ∈ s, (tensorMeasurement A B).effect ab) =
    79	      ∑ a, heteroKron (A.effect a) (B.effect a) := by
    80	    simp [s, Finset.sum_filter, Fintype.sum_prod_type, tensorMeasurement,
    81	      Measurement.ofSumEqOne]
    82	  have h := abs_stateQForm_sub_le_of_contraction _
    83	    (norm_apply_measurement_sum_le (tensorMeasurement A B) s) psi phi hpsi hphi
    84	  rw [heq, stateQForm_finset_sum, stateQForm_finset_sum] at h
    85	  exact h

    87	/-- Averaging evaluated overlaps does not increase the state-transfer cost.
    88	This controls the complete overlap in paper `eq:qld-unitary-9`. -/
    89	theorem evaluated_overlap_state_transfer {Y α R I J : Type*}
    90	    [Fintype Y] [DecidableEq Y] [Nonempty Y]
    91	    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Fintype R] [DecidableEq R]
    92	    [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] [Fintype J] [DecidableEq J]
    93	    (A : Measurement α I) (B : Measurement α J) (eval : α → Y → R)
    94	    (psi phi : EuclideanSpace ℂ (I × J)) (hpsi : ‖psi‖ = 1) (hphi : ‖phi‖ = 1) :
    95	    avgOver (uniformDistribution Y) (fun y => ∑ r, stateQForm psi
    96	      (heteroKron ((A.postprocess (fun a => eval a y)).effect r)
    97	        ((B.postprocess (fun a => eval a y)).effect r))) ≤
    98	      avgOver (uniformDistribution Y) (fun y => ∑ r, stateQForm phi
    99	        (heteroKron ((A.postprocess (fun a => eval a y)).effect r)
   100	          ((B.postprocess (fun a => eval a y)).effect r))) + 2 * ‖psi - phi‖ := by
   101	  have h := avgOver_mono (uniformDistribution Y) _ _ (fun y =>
   102	    (le_abs_self _).trans (abs_diagonal_overlap_state_sub_le
   103	      (A.postprocess (fun a => eval a y)) (B.postprocess (fun a => eval a y))
   104	      psi phi hpsi hphi))
   105	  rw [avgOver_sub, avgOver_const_of_isProbability _
   106	    (uniformDistribution_isProbability _)] at h
   107	  linarith
   108	
   109	/-- Two distinct Pauli answers have encodings agreeing on at most an `md/q`
   110	fraction of points. Injectivity follows from the exact decoder identity. -/
   111	theorem pauli_encoding_collision_le {P : AdmissibleParams}
   112	    (h k : PauliRegister P) (hne : h ≠ k) :
   113	    avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P))
   114	      (fun u => if evalPoly (encodingPoly h) u = evalPoly (encodingPoly k) u
   115	        then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ≤ (P.m * P.d : ℝ) / P.q := by
   116	  apply poly_eval_collision_le
   117	  intro heq
   118	  apply hne
   119	  have hd := congrArg (fun g : Poly P => decodeFq g) heq
   120	  simpa only [decodeFq_lowDegreeEncoding] using hd
   121	
   122	/-- The unevaluated Pauli overlap on a unit comparison state is bounded below
   123	by the evaluated overlap on another unit state, minus the collision and state
   124	errors. This combines paper `eq:qld-unitary-8` with the transfer following
   125	`eq:qld-unitary-9`, without any dimension or answer-count factor. -/
   126	theorem pauli_overlap_transfer {P : AdmissibleParams} {I J : Type*}
   127	    [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] [Fintype J] [DecidableEq J]
   128	    (A : Measurement (PauliRegister P) I) (B : Measurement (PauliRegister P) J)
   129	    (theta ideal : EuclideanSpace ℂ (I × J))
   130	    (htheta : ‖theta‖ = 1) (hideal : ‖ideal‖ = 1) :
   131	    avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)) (fun u =>
   132	      ∑ a : PauliScalar P, stateQForm theta
   133	        (heteroKron ((A.postprocess (fun h => evalPoly (encodingPoly h) u)).effect a)
   134	          ((B.postprocess (fun h => evalPoly (encodingPoly h) u)).effect a))) ≤
   135	      (∑ h, stateQForm ideal (heteroKron (A.effect h) (B.effect h))) +
   136	        (P.m * P.d : ℝ) / P.q + 2 * ‖theta - ideal‖ := by
   137	  have ht := evaluated_overlap_state_transfer A B
   138	    (fun h u => evalPoly (encodingPoly h) u) theta ideal htheta hideal
   139	  have hc := SandwichProduct.avg_diagonal_postprocess_stateQForm_le A B ideal
   140	    (fun h u => evalPoly (encodingPoly h) u) ((P.m * P.d : ℝ) / P.q) hideal
   141	    (by positivity) pauli_encoding_collision_le
   142	  exact ht.trans (add_le_add hc le_rfl)
   143	
   144	end

    24	/-- Coordinate transport preserves the distance between two state vectors. -/
    25	theorem norm_reindexState_sub_eq {I J : Type*}
    26	    [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] [Fintype J] [DecidableEq J]
    27	    (e : I ≃ J) (psi phi : EuclideanSpace ℂ I) :
    28	    ‖reindexState e psi - reindexState e phi‖ = ‖psi - phi‖ := by
    29	  change ‖reindexState e (psi - phi)‖ = _
    30	  exact reindexState_norm_eq e _

    32	/-- The full Pauli comparison with the total measurement on the right block.
    33	This follows from the left-block estimate by exchanging both auxiliary and
    34	extracted registers; the EPR factor is invariant under this exchange. -/
    35	theorem pauli_distance_on_ideal_right_le {P : AdmissibleParams} {I J : Type*}
    36	    [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] [Fintype J] [DecidableEq J]
    37	    (A : Measurement (PauliRegister P) (J × PauliRegister P)) (W : PauliKind)
    38	    (aux : EuclideanSpace ℂ (I × J)) (haux : ‖aux‖ = 1)
    39	    (theta : EuclideanSpace ℂ ((I × PauliRegister P) × (J × PauliRegister P)))
    40	    (htheta : ‖theta‖ = 1) :
    41	    let ideal := reindexState prodShuffle (vecTensor aux (eprState (PauliRegister P)))
    42	    let B := rightPlacedMeasurement (ιA := I) (pauliRegisterMeas (params := P) W)
    43	    (∑ h : PauliRegister P, ‖applyOperatorToState
    44	      (heteroKron (1 : Op (I × PauliRegister P))
    45	        (A.effect h - heteroKron (1 : Op J) (pauliProj W h))) ideal‖ ^ 2) ≤
    46	      2 * (1 - avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)) (fun u =>
    47	        ∑ a : PauliScalar P, stateQForm theta
    48	          (heteroKron ((B.postprocess (fun h => evalPoly (encodingPoly h) u)).effect a)
    49	            ((A.postprocess (fun h => evalPoly (encodingPoly h) u)).effect a)))) +
    50	        2 * ((P.m * P.d : ℝ) / P.q) + 4 * ‖theta - ideal‖ := by
    51	  let e := Equiv.prodComm (I × PauliRegister P) (J × PauliRegister P)
    52	  let ideal := reindexState prodShuffle (vecTensor aux (eprState (PauliRegister P)))
    53	  have hideal : reindexState prodShuffle
    54	      (vecTensor (reindexState (Equiv.prodComm I J) aux) (eprState (PauliRegister P))) =
    55	      reindexState e ideal := by
    56	    ext p
    57	    simp [reindexState, vecTensor, prodShuffle, eprState, e, ideal, eq_comm]
    58	  have h := pauli_distance_on_ideal_le A W (reindexState (Equiv.prodComm I J) aux)
    59	    (by rw [reindexState_norm_eq, haux]) (reindexState e theta)
    60	    (by rw [reindexState_norm_eq, htheta])
    61	  dsimp only at h ⊢
    62	  rw [hideal, norm_reindexState_sub_eq] at h
    63	  dsimp only [e] at h
    64	  simp_rw [WinImplications.norm_applyOperatorToState_reindexState,
    65	    WinImplications.stateQForm_reindexState, WinImplications.reindexOp_prodComm_heteroKron] at h
    66	  exact h

    73	/-- The evaluated total-Pauli consistency defect against the opposite
    74	pulled-apart measurement, with the tensor factors in Alice--Bob order. -/
    75	def evaluatedPauliDefect (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG) (side : PlayerSide)
    76	    (W : PauliKind) : ℝ :=
    77	  match side with
    78	  | .alice => consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P))
    79	      (fun u a => S.placePlayer .alice ((S.pauliEvalMeas .alice W u).effect a))
    80	      (fun u a => S.placeSide .bob (tildeM w .bob W (indicatorVec u) a)) S.psiHat
    81	  | .bob => consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P))
    82	      (fun u a => S.placeSide .alice (tildeM w .alice W (indicatorVec u) a))
    83	      (fun u a => S.placePlayer .bob ((S.pauliEvalMeas .bob W u).effect a)) S.psiHat
    84	
    85	/-- The ideal state in local extraction-block order. -/
    86	theorem reindexState_idealExpState_blocks
    87	    (aux : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ExtractionAuxRegisters P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)) :
    88	    reindexState (sixRegExtractionEquiv P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)
    89	      (S.idealExpState aux) = reindexState prodShuffle (vecTensor aux
    90	        (eprState (PauliRegister P))) := by
    91	  rfl

    93	/-- Subtraction of block operators agrees with subtraction after placement. -/
    94	theorem placeSide_sub (side : PlayerSide)
    95	    (A B : Op (ExtractionBlock P (S.LocalSpace side))) :
    96	    S.placeSide side (A - B) = S.placeSide side A - S.placeSide side B := by
    97	  cases side
    98	  · ext row col
    99	    exact sub_mul _ _ _
   100	  · ext row col
   101	    exact mul_sub _ _ _
   102	
   103	/-- The entire answer-summed distance in block coordinates is the distance
   104	appearing in `ExtractionWitness.pauli_close`, for either player. -/
   105	theorem extraction_pauli_dist_eq_sum (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG)
   106	    (aux : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ExtractionAuxRegisters P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB))
   107	    (side : PlayerSide) (W : PauliKind) :
   108	    opFamilyDistSq (uniformDistribution Unit)
   109	      (fun (_ : Unit) (h : PauliRegister P) =>
   110	        conjBy (S.placeSide side (swapUnitary w side))
   111	          (S.placePlayer side ((S.pauliMeas side W).effect h)))
   112	      (fun (_ : Unit) (h : PauliRegister P) =>
   113	        S.placeExtractedRegister side (pauliProj W h)) (S.idealExpState aux) =
   114	      ∑ h : PauliRegister P, ‖applyOperatorToState
   115	        (S.placeSide side (((S.swappedPauliMeas w side W).effect h) -
   116	          heteroKron (1 : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace side)) (pauliProj W h)))
   117	        (S.idealExpState aux)‖ ^ 2 := by
   118	  simp_rw [S.placeSide_sub, S.placeSide_swappedPauliMeas, S.placeSide_extracted]
   119	  exact avgOver_uniform_const _
